 16210                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16211                                  ; Proc Name : Check_If_Net:
 16212                                  ;
 16213                                  ;
 16214                                  ; Checks if the device is over the net or not. Returns result in ZERO flag.
 16215                                  ; If no device is found, the return address is popped off the stack, and a
 16216                                  ; jump is made to ioctl_drv_err.
 16217                                  ;
 16218                                  ; On Entry:
 16219                                  ; Registers same as those for Get_Driver_BL
 16220                                  ;
 16221                                  ; On Exit:
 16222                                  ; ZERO flag	- set if not a net device
 16223                                  ;		- reset if net device
 16224                                  ; ES:DI -> the device
 16225                                  ;
 16226                                  ;
 16227                                  ; BUGBUG: This function assumes the following stack setup on entry
 16228                                  ;
 16229                                  ;	  SP+2 -> Error return address
 16230                                  ;	  SP   -> Normal return address
 16231                                  ;
 16232                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16233                                  
 16234                                  	; 30/01/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 16235                                  	; MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:639Ch
 16236                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:6A91h
 16237                                  	; Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:68E1h
 16238                                  
 16239                                  Check_If_Net:
 16240                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 (& MSDOS 6.0)
 16241 0000244C E8D0FF                  	CALL	Get_Driver_BL
 16242 0000244F 7201                    	JC	short ioctl_drv_err_pop	; invalid drive letter
 16243                                  
 16244                                  ; 30/01/2024 ('Get_Driver_BL' returns with
 16245                                  ;	      'curdir_isnet' condition/ZF, no need to a second test)
 16246                                  %if 0
 16247                                  	;;;
 16248                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM, Windows ME IO.SYS)
 16249                                  	PUSH	ES
 16250                                  	PUSH	DI
 16251                                  	LES	DI,[THISCDS]
 16252                                  	;test	word [es:di+43h],8000h
 16253                                  	;TEST	word [ES:DI+curdir.flags],curdir_isnet
 16254                                  	;test	byte [es:di+44h],80h
 16255                                  	TEST	byte [ES:DI+curdir.flags+1],(curdir_isnet>>8)
 16256                                  	POP	DI
 16257                                  	POP	ES
 16258                                  	;;;
 16259                                  %endif
 16260 00002451 C3                      	retn

 16382                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16383                                  ;
 16384                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_DELETE
 16385                                  ;
 16386                                  ; Inputs:
 16387                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 16388                                  ;		terminated)
 16389                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 16390                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 16391                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 16392                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 16393                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 16394                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 16395                                  ; Function:
 16396                                  ;	Delete the specified file(s)
 16397                                  ; Outputs:
 16398                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 16399                                  ;		OK
 16400                                  ;	CARRY SET
 16401                                  ;	    AX is error code
 16402                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 16403                                  ;			Last element of path not found
 16404                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 16405                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 16406                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 16407                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 16408                                  ;		error_access_denied
 16409                                  ;			Attempt to delete device or directory
 16410                                  ;		***error_sharing_violation***
 16411                                  ;			Deny both access required, generates an INT 24.
 16412                                  ;			This error is NOT returned. The INT 24H is generated,
 16413                                  ;			  and the file is ignored (not deleted). Delete will
 16414                                  ;			  simply continue on looking for more files.
 16415                                  ;			  Carry will NOT be set in this case.
 16416                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 16417                                  ;
 16418                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16419                                  
 16420                                  FILEFOUND   equ 01h
 16421                                  FILEDELETED equ 10h
 16422                                  
 16423                                  
 16424                                  	; 12/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)

 16446                                  			; SS = DS = DOS CS, SDA first filename pointer -> 
 16447                                  			;		fully-qualified filename in DOS CS
 16448                                  			; SDA CDS pointer -> current directory structure for drive with file

 16906                                  ;	TITLE	DOS_RENAME - Internal RENAME call for MS-DOS
 16907                                  ;	NAME	DOS_RENAME
 16908                                  
 16909                                  ;**	Low level routine for renaming files
 16910                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16911                                  ;	DOS_RENAME
 16912                                  ;
 16913                                  ;	Modification history:
 16914                                  ;
 16915                                  ;	    Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 16916                                  
 16917                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16918                                  ;
 16919                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_RENAME
 16920                                  ;
 16921                                  ; Inputs:
 16922                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to SOURCE WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3
 16923                                  ;		chars, NUL terminated)
 16924                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string [SOURCE]
 16925                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 16926                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 16927                                  ;	[REN_WFP] Points to DEST WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3
 16928                                  ;		chars, NUL terminated)
 16929                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 16930                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 16931                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 16932                                  ; Function:
 16933                                  ;	Rename the specified file(s)
 16934                                  ;	NOTE: This routine uses most of AUXSTACK as a temp buffer.
 16935                                  ; Outputs:
 16936                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 16937                                  ;	    OK
 16938                                  ;	CARRY SET
 16939                                  ;	    AX is error code
 16940                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 16941                                  ;			No match for source, or dest path invalid
 16942                                  ;		error_not_same_device
 16943                                  ;			Source and dest are on different devices
 16944                                  ;		error_access_denied
 16945                                  ;			Directory specified (not simple rename),
 16946                                  ;			Device name given, Destination exists.
 16947                                  ;			NOTE: In third case some renames may have
 16948                                  ;			 been done if metas.
 16949                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 16950                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 16951                                  ;			SOURCE ONLY
 16952                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 16953                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 16954                                  ;			SOURCE ONLY
 16955                                  ;		error_sharing_violation
 16956                                  ;			Deny both access required, generates an INT 24.
 16957                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 16958                                  ;
 16959                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16960                                  
 16961                                  	; 14/11/2022 Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 16962                                  
 16963                                  	; 31/01/2024
 16964                                  
 16965                                  DOS_RENAME:
 16966                                  
 16967                                  ;hkn; DOS_RENAME is called from file.asm and fcbio.asm. DS has been set up
 16968                                  ;hkn; at this point to DOSDATA.
 16969                                  
 16970 00002674 E8B2EB                  	call	TestNet
 16971 00002677 7306                    	JNC	short LOCAL_RENAME
 16972                                  
 16973                                  ;IF NOT Installed
 16974                                  ;	transfer NET_RENAME
 16975                                  ;ELSE
 16976                                  	;MOV	AX,(MultNET SHL 8) OR 17
 16977                                  	;INT	2FH
 16978                                  	;return
 16979                                  
 16980 00002679 B81111                  	mov     ax, 1111h
 16981 0000267C CD2F                    	int     2Fh 	; Multiplex - NETWORK REDIRECTOR - RENAME REMOTE FILE
 16982                                  			; SS = DS = DOS CS, 
 16983                                  			; SDA first filename pointer = offset of fully-qualified old name
 16984                                  			; SDA CDS pointer -> current directory
 16985                                  			; Return: CF set on error
 16986 0000267E C3                      	retn
 16987                                  ;ENDIF
 16988

 17806                                  ;** 	Low level DUP routine for use by EXEC when creating a new process.
 17807                                  ;   	Exports the DUP to the server machine and increments the SFT ref count
 17808                                  ;
 17809                                  ;	DOS_DUP
 17810                                  ;
 17811                                  ;	Modification history:
 17812                                  ;
 17813                                  ;	  Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 17814                                  
 17815                                  ;BREAK <DOS_DUP -- DUP SFT across network>
 17816                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17817                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_DUP
 17818                                  ;
 17819                                  ; Inputs:
 17820                                  ;	[THISSFT] set to the SFT for the file being DUPed
 17821                                  ;		(a non net SFT is OK, in this case the ref
 17822                                  ;		 count is simply incremented)
 17823                                  ; Function:
 17824                                  ;	Signal to the devices that a logical open is occurring
 17825                                  ; Returns:
 17826                                  ;	ES:DI point to SFT
 17827                                  ;    Carry clear
 17828                                  ;	SFT ref_count is incremented
 17829                                  ; Registers modified: None.
 17830                                  ; NOTE:
 17831                                  ;	This routine is called from $CREATE_PROCESS_DATA_BLOCK at DOSINIT
 17832                                  ;	time with SS NOT DOSGROUP. There will be no Network handles at
 17833                                  ;	that time.
 17834                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17835                                  
 17836                                  DOS_DUP:
 17837                                  	;LES	DI,[CS:THISSFT]  ; MSDOS 3.3
 17838                                  
 17839                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 17840 00002979 2E8E06[0700]            	mov	es,[cs:DosDSeg]
 17841 0000297E 26C43E[9E05]            	les	di,[es:THISSFT]
 17842                                  
 17843                                  	;Entry	Dos_Dup_Direct
 17844                                  DOS_Dup_Direct:
 17845 00002983 E8BCE8                  	call	IsSFTNet
 17846 00002986 7503                    	JNZ	short DO_INC
 17847 00002988 E8FA1A                  	call	DEV_OPEN_SFT
 17848                                  DO_INC:
 17849                                  	;INC	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count]
 17850 0000298B 26FF05                  	inc	word [ES:DI]		; Clears carry (if this ever wraps
 17851                                  					;   we're in big trouble anyway)
 17852 0000298E C3                      	retn

 17860                                  ;TITLE	DOS_CREATE/DOS_CREATE_NEW - Internal CREATE calls for MS-DOS
 17861                                  ;NAME	DOS_CREATE
 17862                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17863                                  ;**	Internal Create and Create new to create a local or NET file and SFT.
 17864                                  ;
 17865                                  ;	DOS_CREATE
 17866                                  ;	DOS_CREATE_NEW
 17867                                  ;	SET_MKND_ERR
 17868                                  ;	SET_Media_ID
 17869                                  ;	SET_EXT_Mode
 17870                                  ;
 17871                                  ;	Revision history:
 17872                                  ;
 17873                                  ;	    A000 version 4.00	  Jan. 1988
 17874                                  ;	    A001  D490 -- Change IOCTL subfunctios from 63h,43h to 66h, 46h
 17875                                  
 17876                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 17877                                  
 17878                                  ;	i_need	THISSFT,DWORD
 17879                                  ;	i_need	THISCDS,DWORD
 17880                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR,WORD
 17881                                  ;	I_Need	ExtErr_locus,BYTE
 17882                                  ;	I_need	JShare,DWORD
 17883                                  ;	I_need	VOLCHNG_FLAG,BYTE
 17884                                  ;	I_need	SATTRIB,BYTE
 17885                                  ;	I_need	CALLVIDM,DWORD
 17886                                  ;	I_need	EXTOPEN_ON,BYTE 		  ;AN000; extended open
 17887                                  ;	I_need	NAME1,BYTE			  ;AN000;
 17888                                  ;	I_need	NO_NAME_ID,BYTE 		  ;AN000;
 17889                                  ;	I_need	Packet_Temp,WORD		  ;AN000;
 17890                                  ;	I_need	DOS34_FLAG,WORD 		  ;AN000;
 17891                                  ;	I_need	SAVE_BX,WORD			  ;AN000;
 17892                                  
 17893                                  ;***	DOS_CREATE - Create a File
 17894                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17895                                  ;	DOS_Create is called to create the specified file, truncating
 17896                                  ;	the old one if it exists.
 17897                                  ;
 17898                                  ;	ENTRY	AX is Attribute to create
 17899                                  ;		(ds) = DOSDATA
 17900                                  ;		[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 17901                                  ;			terminated)
 17902                                  ;		[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 17903                                  ;			( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 17904                                  ;			 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 17905                                  ;		[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 17906                                  ;			(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 17907                                  ;		[THISSFT] Points to SFT to fill in if file created
 17908                                  ;			(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 17909                                  ;		[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 17910                                  ;
 17911                                  ;	EXIT	sf_ref_count is NOT altered
 17912                                  ;		CARRY CLEAR
 17913                                  ;		    THISSFT filled in.
 17914                                  ;			sf_mode = unchanged for FCB, sharing_compat + open_for_both
 17915                                  ;		CARRY SET
 17916                                  ;		    AX is error code
 17917                                  ;			error_path_not_found
 17918                                  ;				Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 17919                                  ;			error_bad_curr_dir
 17920                                  ;				Bad path in current directory part of path
 17921                                  ;			error_access_denied
 17922                                  ;				Attempt to re-create read only file , or
 17923                                  ;				create a second volume id or create a dir
 17924                                  ;			error_sharing_violation
 17925                                  ;				The sharing mode was correct but not allowed
 17926                                  ;				generates an INT 24
 17927                                  ;	USES	all but DS

 18177                                  ; Inputs:
 18178                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 18179                                  ;		terminated)
 18180                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 18181                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 18182                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)

 18184                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))

 18186                                  ;		(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 18187                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 18188                                  ;	AX is Attribute to create

 18190                                  ;	Try to create the specified file truncating an old one that exists
 18191                                  ; Outputs:

 18194                                  ;	    THISSFT filled in.
 18195                                  ;		sf_mode = sharing_compat + open_for_both for Non-FCB SFT
 18196                                  ;	CARRY SET
 18197                                  ;	    AX is error code
 18198                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 18199                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 18200                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 18201                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 18202                                  ;		error_access_denied
 18203                                  ;			Create a second volume id or create a dir
 18204                                  ;		error_file_exists

 18206                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed

 18338                                  
 18339                                  ;	TITLE	DOS_OPEN - Internal OPEN call for MS-DOS
 18340                                  ;	NAME	DOS_OPEN
 18341                                  
 18342                                  ;**	OPEN.ASM - File Open
 18343                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18344                                  ;	Low level routines for openning a file from a file spec.
 18345                                  ;	Also misc routines for sharing errors
 18346                                  ;
 18347                                  ;	DOS_Open
 18348                                  ;	Check_Access_AX
 18349                                  ;	SHARE_ERROR
 18350                                  ;	SET_SFT_MODE
 18351                                  ;	Code_Page_Mismatched_Error		   ; DOS 4.00
 18352                                  ;
 18353                                  ;	Revision history:
 18354                                  ;
 18355                                  ;	    Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 18356                                  ;	    A000	version 4.00   Jan. 1988
 18357                                  ;
 18358                                  ;	M034 - The value in save_bx must be pushed on to the stack for
 18359                                  ; 	       remote extended opens and not save_cx.
 18360                                  ;
 18361                                  ;	M035 - if open made from exec then we must set the appropriate bits
 18362                                  ;	       on the stack before calling off to the redir.
 18363                                  ;	M042 - Bit 11 of DOS34_FLAG set indicates that the redir knows how 
 18364                                  ;	       to handle open from exec. In this case set the appropriate bit
 18365                                  ;	       else do not.
 18366                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------	
 18367                                  
 18368                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 18369                                  
 18370                                  ;	i_need	NoSetDir,BYTE
 18371                                  ;	i_need	THISSFT,DWORD
 18372                                  ;	i_need	THISCDS,DWORD
 18373                                  ;	i_need	CURBUF,DWORD
 18374                                  ;	i_need	CurrentPDB,WORD
 18375                                  ;	i_need	CURR_DIR_END,WORD
 18376                                  ;	I_need	RetryCount,WORD
 18377                                  ;	I_need	Open_Access,BYTE
 18378                                  ;	I_need	fSharing,BYTE
 18379                                  ;	i_need	JShare,DWORD
 18380                                  ;	I_need	FastOpenFlg,byte
 18381                                  ;	I_need	EXTOPEN_ON,BYTE 		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18382                                  ;	I_need	ALLOWED,BYTE			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18383                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR,WORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18384                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_LOCUS,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18385                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_ACTION,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18386                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_CLASS,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18387                                  ;	I_need	CPSWFLAG,BYTE			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00

 18389                                  ;	I_need	THISDPB,DWORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18390                                  ;	I_need	SAVE_CX,WORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18391                                  ;	I_need	SAVE_BX,WORD			  ;M034

 18396                                  ;Break	<DOS_Open - internal file access>
 18397                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18398                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_Open
 18399                                  ;
 18400                                  ; Inputs:
 18401                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 18402                                  ;		terminated)
 18403                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 18404                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 18405                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 18406                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 18407                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 18408                                  ;	[THISSFT] Points to SFT to fill in if file found
 18409                                  ;		(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 18410                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 18411                                  ;	AX is Access and Sharing mode
 18412                                  ;	  High NIBBLE of AL (Sharing Mode)
 18413                                  ;		sharing_compat	   file is opened in compatibility mode
 18414                                  ;		sharing_deny_none  file is opened Multi reader, Multi writer
 18415                                  ;		sharing_deny_read  file is opened Only reader, Multi writer
 18416                                  ;		sharing_deny_write file is opened Multi reader, Only writer
 18417                                  ;		sharing_deny_both  file is opened Only reader, Only writer
 18418                                  ;	  Low NIBBLE of AL (Access Mode)
 18419                                  ;		open_for_read	file is opened for reading
 18420                                  ;		open_for_write	file is opened for writing
 18421                                  ;		open_for_both	file is opened for both reading and writing.
 18422                                  ;
 18423                                  ;	  For FCB SFTs AL should = sharing_compat + open_for_both
 18424                                  ;		(not checked)
 18425                                  ; Function:
 18426                                  ;	Try to open the specified file
 18427                                  ; Outputs:
 18428                                  ;	sf_ref_count is NOT altered
 18429                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 18430                                  ;	    THISSFT filled in.
 18431                                  ;	CARRY SET
 18432                                  ;	    AX is error code
 18433                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 18434                                  ;			Last element of path not found
 18435                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 18436                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 18437                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 18438                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 18439                                  ;		error_invalid_access
 18440                                  ;			Bad sharing mode or bad access mode or bad combination
 18441                                  ;		error_access_denied
 18442                                  ;			Attempt to open read only file for writting, or
 18443                                  ;			open a directory
 18444                                  ;		error_sharing_violation
 18445                                  ;			The sharing mode was correct but not allowed
 18446                                  ;			generates an INT 24 on compatibility mode SFTs
 18447                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 18448                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18449                                  
 18450                                  ; 18/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0

 18816                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18817                                  ; Procedure Name : Check_Access
 18818                                  ;
 18819                                  ; Inputs:
 18820                                  ;	AX is mode
 18821                                  ;	  High NIBBLE of AL (Sharing Mode)
 18822                                  ;		sharing_compat	   file is opened in compatibility mode
 18823                                  ;		sharing_deny_none  file is opened Multi reader, Multi writer
 18824                                  ;		sharing_deny_read  file is opened Only reader, Multi writer
 18825                                  ;		sharing_deny_write file is opened Multi reader, Only writer
 18826                                  ;		sharing_deny_both  file is opened Only reader, Only writer
 18827                                  ;	  Low NIBBLE of AL (Access Mode)
 18828                                  ;		open_for_read	file is opened for reading
 18829                                  ;		open_for_write	file is opened for writing
 18830                                  ;		open_for_both	file is opened for both reading and writing.
 18831                                  ; Function:
 18832                                  ;	Check this access mode for correctness
 18833                                  ; Outputs:
 18834                                  ;	[open_access] = AL input
 18835                                  ;	Carry Clear
 18836                                  ;		Mode is correct
 18837                                  ;		AX unchanged
 18838                                  ;	Carry Set
 18839                                  ;		Mode is bad
 18840                                  ;		AX = error_invalid_access
 18841                                  ; No other registers effected
 18842                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18843                                  
 18844                                  Check_Access_AX:

 18891                                  ;**	Low level routine for returning disk drive information from a local
 18892                                  ;	  or NET device
 18893                                  ;

 18896                                  ;	  Modification history:
 18897                                  ;
 18898                                  ;		Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 18899                                  
 18900                                  ;	Break	<DISK_INFO -- Get Disk Drive Information>
 18901                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18902                                  ; Procedure Name : DISK_INFO
 18903                                  ;
 18904                                  ; Inputs:
 18905                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to the Macro List Structure of interest
 18906                                  ;		(It MAY NOT be NUL, error not detected)
 18907                                  ; Function:
 18908                                  ;	Get Interesting Drive Information
 18909                                  ; Returns:
 18910                                  ;	DX = Number of free allocation units
 18911                                  ;	BX = Total Number of allocation units on disk
 18912                                  ;	CX = Sector size
 18913                                  ;	AL = Sectors per allocation unit
 18914                                  ;	AH = FAT ID BYTE
 18915                                  ;	Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 18916                                  ; Segs except ES preserved, others destroyed
 18917                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18918                                  
 18919                                  ;hkn; called from getset.asm and misc.asm. DS has already been set up to 
 18920                                  ;hkn; DOSDATA. 
 18921                                  
 18922                                  DISK_INFO:
 18923                                  	; 08/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0

 18934                                  	;return
 18935

 18937 00002C23 CD2F                    	int     2Fh	; Multiplex - NETWORK REDIRECTOR - GET DISK SPACE
 18938                                  			; ES:DI -> current directory
 18939                                  			; Return: AL = sectors per cluster, BX = total clusters
 18940                                  			; CX = bytes per sector, DX = number of available clusters
 18941 00002C25 C3                      	retn

 18962                                  ; Examine the current free count. If it indicates that we have an invalid
 18963                                  ; count, do the expensive calculation.
 18964

 18971                                  ; Otherwise, we need to blast out an internal error message and then recompute

 18988                                  ReturnVals:

 19009 00002C79 EBE9                    	JMP	short ReturnVals

 19016                                  ;	TITLE	DOS_SEARCH - Internal SEARCH calls for MS-DOS
 19017                                  ;	NAME	DOS_SEARCH
 19018                                  
 19019                                  ;**	Low level routines for doing local and NET directory searches
 19020                                  ;
 19021                                  ;	DOS_SEARCH_FIRST
 19022                                  ;	DOS_SEARCH_NEXT
 19023                                  ;	RENAME_NEXT
 19024                                  ;
 19025                                  ;	Revision history:
 19026                                  ;
 19027                                  ;	    Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 19028                                  ;	    A000	version 4.00  Jan. 1988
 19029                                  ;	    A001	PTM 3564 -- search for fastopen
 19030                                  
 19031                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 19032                                  
 19033                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19034                                  ;
 19035                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_SEARCH_FIRST
 19036                                  ;
 19037                                  ; Inputs:
 19038                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 19039                                  ;		terminated)
 19040                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 19041                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 19042                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 19043                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 19044                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 19045                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 19046                                  ;	[DMAADD] Points to 53 byte buffer
 19047                                  ; Function:
 19048                                  ;	Initiate a search for the given file spec
 19049                                  ; Outputs:
 19050                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 19051                                  ;	    The 53 bytes ot DMAADD are filled in as follows:
 19052                                  ;
 19053                                  ;	LOCAL
 19054                                  ;	    Drive Byte (A=1, B=2, ...) High bit clear
 19055                                  ;		NEVER STORE DRIVE BYTE AFTER  found_it
 19056                                  ;	    11 byte search name with Meta chars in it
 19057                                  ;	    Search Attribute Byte, attribute of search
 19058                                  ;	    WORD LastEnt value
 19059                                  ;	    WORD DirStart
 19060                                  ;	    4 byte pad
 19061                                  ;	    32 bytes of the directory entry found
 19062                                  ;	NET
 19063                                  ;	    21 bytes First byte has high bit set
 19064                                  ;	    32 bytes of the directory entry found
 19065                                  ;
 19066                                  ;	CARRY SET
 19067                                  ;	    AX = error code
 19068                                  ;		error_no_more_files
 19069                                  ;			No match for this file
 19070                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 19071                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 19072                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 19073                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 19074                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 19075                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19076                                  
 19077                                  ; 24/01/2024

 19313                                  ;BREAK <DOS_SEARCH_NEXT - scan for subsequent matches>
 19314                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19315                                  ;
 19316                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_SEARCH_NEXT
 19317                                  ;
 19318                                  ; Inputs:
 19319                                  ;	[DMAADD] Points to 53 byte buffer returned by DOS_SEARCH_FIRST
 19320                                  ;	    (only first 21 bytes must have valid information)
 19321                                  ; Function:
 19322                                  ;	Look for subsequent matches
 19323                                  ; Outputs:
 19324                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 19325                                  ;	    The 53 bytes at DMAADD are updated for next call
 19326                                  ;		(see DOS_SEARCH_FIRST)
 19327                                  ;	CARRY SET
 19328                                  ;	    AX = error code
 19329                                  ;		error_no_more_files

 19479                                  ;**
 19480                                  ;
 19481                                  ; Internal Abort call closes all handles and FCBs associated with a process.
 19482                                  ;  If process has NET resources a close all is sent out over the net.
 19483                                  ;
 19484                                  ;   DOS_ABORT
 19485                                  ;
 19486                                  ;   Modification history:
 19487                                  ;
 19488                                  ;       Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 19489                                  ;
 19490                                  ;	M038	SR	10/16/90	Free SFT with the PSP of the process
 19491                                  ;				being terminated only if it is busy.
 19492                                  ;
 19493                                  
 19494                                  ;Break   <DOS_ABORT -- CLOSE all files for process>
 19495                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19496                                  ;
 19497                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_ABORT
 19498                                  ;
 19499                                  ; Inputs:
 19500                                  ;       [CurrentPDB] set to PID of process aborting
 19501                                  ; Function:
 19502                                  ;       Close all files and free all SFTs for this PID
 19503                                  ; Returns:
 19504                                  ;       None
 19505                                  ; All destroyed except stack
 19506                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19507                                  
 19508                                  DOS_ABORT:
 19509 00002DFC 368E06[3003]            	MOV     ES,[SS:CurrentPDB]	; SS override
 19510 00002E01 268B0E3200              	MOV     CX,[ES:PDB.JFN_Length]  ; Number of JFNs
 19511                                  reset_free_jfn:
 19512 00002E06 89CB                    	MOV     BX,CX
 19513 00002E08 51                      	PUSH    CX
 19514 00002E09 4B                      	DEC     BX                      ; get jfn (start with last one)
 19515                                  
 19516 00002E0A E84A37                  	CALL	_$CLOSE
 19517 00002E0D 59                      	POP     CX
 19518 00002E0E E2F6                    	LOOP    reset_free_jfn          ; and do 'em all
 19519                                  
 19520                                  ; Note: We do need to explicitly close FCBs. Reasons are as follows: If we
 19521                                  ; are running in the no-sharing no-network environment, we are simulating the
 19522                                  ; 2.0 world and thus if the user doesn't close the file, that is his problem
 19523                                  ; BUT... the cache remains in a state with garbage that may be reused by the
 19524                                  ; next process. We scan the set and blast the ref counts of the FCBs we own.
 19525                                  ;
 19526                                  ; If sharing is loaded, then the following call to close process will
 19527                                  ; correctly close all FCBs. We will then need to walk the list AFTER here.
 19528                                  ;
 19529                                  ; Finally, the following call to NET_Abort will cause an EOP to be sent to all
 19530                                  ; known network resources. These resources are then responsible for cleaning
 19531                                  ; up after this process.
 19532                                  ;
 19533                                  ; Sleazy, eh?
 19534                                  
 19535                                  	;context DS			; SS is DOSDATA
 19536 00002E10 16                      	push	ss
 19537 00002E11 1F                      	pop	ds  ; 09/09/2018
 19538                                  
 19539                                  	;CallInstall Net_Abort, MultNET, 29
 19540 00002E12 B81D11                  	mov	ax,111Dh
 19541 00002E15 CD2F                    	int     2Fh 	; Multiplex - NETWORK REDIRECTOR 
 19542                                  			;	    - CLOSE ALL REMOTE FILES FOR PROCESS
 19543                                  			; DS???, SS = DOS CS
 19544                                  ;if installed
 19545 00002E17 FF1E[A000]              	call	far [JShare+(4*4)]	; 4 = MFTCloseP
 19546                                  ;else
 19547                                  ;	call 	MFTCloseP
 19548                                  ;endif
 19549                                  
 19550                                  ; Scan the FCB cache for guys that belong to this process and zap their ref
 19551                                  ; counts.
 19552                                  					; SS override
 19553 00002E1B 36C43E[4000]            	les     di,[ss:SFTFCB]		; grab the pointer to the table
 19554                                  	;mov	cx,[es:di+4]
 19555 00002E20 268B4D04                	mov     cx,[es:di+SFT.SFCount]
 19556 00002E24 E317                    	jcxz    FCBScanDone

 19558 00002E26 8D7D06                  	LEA     DI,[DI+SFT.SFTable]	; point at table
 19559 00002E29 36A1[3C03]              	mov     ax,[SS:PROC_ID]		; SS override
 19560                                  FCBTest:
 19561                                  	;cmp	[es:di+31h],ax
 19562 00002E2D 26394531                	cmp	[es:di+SF_ENTRY.sf_PID],ax ; is this one of ours
 19563 00002E31 7505                    	jnz	short FCBNext		; no, skip it
 19564 00002E33 26C7050000              	mov	word [es:di],0
 19565                                  	;mov	word [es:di+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count],0  ; yes, blast ref count
 19566                                  FCBNext:
 19567 00002E38 83C73B                  	add     di,SF_ENTRY.size ; 59 (for MSDOS 6.0)
 19568 00002E3B E2F0                    	loop    FCBTest
 19569                                  FCBScanDone:
 19570                                  
 19571                                  ; Walk the SFT to eliminate all busy SFT's for this process.
 19572                                  
 19573 00002E3D 31DB                    	XOR     BX,BX
 19574                                  Scan:

 19577 00002E43 5B                      	pop     bx
 19578                                  	;jnc	short Scan1
 19579                                  	;retn
 19580                                  
 19581                                  	; 18/12/2022
 19582                                  	;jc	short NO_Question ; retn
 19583                                  	; 03/02/2024
 19584 00002E44 7234                    	jc	short RET2
 19585                                  
 19586                                  ;M038
 19587                                  ; Do what the comment above says, check for busy state
 19588

 20861                                  ;	Perform read operation
 20862                                  ; Outputs:

 21404                                  ;Break	<DOS_WRITE -- MAIN WRITE ROUTINE AND DEVICE OUT ROUTINES>
 21405                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21406                                  ;
 21407                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_WRITE
 21408                                  ;
 21409                                  ; Inputs:
 21410                                  ;	ThisSFT set to the SFT for the file being used
 21411                                  ;	[DMAADD] contains transfer address
 21412                                  ;	CX = No. of bytes to write
 21413                                  ; Function:
 21414                                  ;	Perform write operation
 21415                                  ;	NOTE: If CX = 0 on input, file is truncated or grown
 21416                                  ;		to current sf_position
 21417                                  ; Outputs:
 21418                                  ;    Carry clear
 21419                                  ;	SFT Position and cluster pointers updated
 21420                                  ;	CX = No. of bytes written
 21421                                  ;	ES:DI point to SFT
 21422                                  ;    Carry set
 21423                                  ;	AX is error code
 21424                                  ;	CX = 0
 21425                                  ;	ES:DI point to SFT
 21426                                  ; DS preserved, all other registers destroyed
 21427                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21428                                  
 21429                                  ;hkn; called from fcbio2.asm, handle.asm and dev.asm. DS is set up at this 
 21430                                  ;hkn; point to DOSDATA.
 21431                                  
 21432                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 21433                                  ; DOSCODE:742Ch (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)

 21436                                  ; DOSCODE:7418h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 21449                                  
 21450                                  ; NOTE: The following check for writting to a Read Only File is performed
 21451                                  ;	    ONLY on FCBs!!!!
 21452                                  ;	We ALLOW writes to Read Only files via handles to allow a CREATE
 21453                                  ;	    of a read only file which can then be written to.
 21454                                  ;	This is OK because we are NOT ALLOWED to OPEN a RO file via handles
 21455                                  ;	    for writting, or RE-CREATE an EXISTING RO file via handles. Thus,
 21456                                  ;	    CREATing a NEW RO file, or RE-CREATing an existing file which
 21457                                  ;	    is NOT RO to be RO, via handles are the only times we can write
 21458                                  ;	    to a read-only file.
 21459

 21768                                  ;Break	<DIRREAD -- READ A DIRECTORY SECTOR>
 21769                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------

 21771                                  ; Procedure Name : DIRREAD
 21772                                  ;
 21773                                  ; Inputs:
 21774                                  ;	AX = Directory block number (relative to first block of directory)
 21775                                  ;	ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 21776                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = First sector of first cluster of directory
 21777                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Next cluster
 21778                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors/Cluster
 21779                                  ; Function:
 21780                                  ;	Read the directory block into [CURBUF].
 21781                                  ; Outputs:
 21782                                  ;	[NXTCLUSNUM] = Next cluster (after the one skipped to)
 21783                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] Set

 21785                                  ;	[CURBUF] Points to Buffer with dir sector
 21786                                  ;	Carry set if error (user said FAIL to I 24)
 21787                                  ; DS preserved, all other registers destroyed.
 21788                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21789                                  
 21790                                  ;hkn; called from dir.asm. DS already set up to DOSDATA.
 21791                                  
 21792                                  DIRREAD:
 21793                                  
 21794                                  ; Note that ClusFac is the sectors per cluster. This is NOT necessarily
 21795                                  ; the same as what is in the DPB! In the case of the root directory, we have
 21796                                  ; ClusFac = # sectors in the root directory. The root directory is detected
 21797                                  ; by DIRStart = 0.

 21799 00003565 31D2                    	XOR	DX,DX
 21800                                  	;CMP	word [DIRSTART],0
 21801                                  	; 21/09/2023

 21804 0000356D 92                      	XCHG	AX,DX
 21805 0000356E EB0C                    	JMP	short DoRead
 21806                                  
 21807                                  ; Convert the sector number in AX into cluster and sector-within-cluster pair
 21808                                  
 21809                                  SubDir:

 21818 0000357A D3E8                    	SHR	AX,CL

 21821                                  ;	(AX) = number of clusters to skip

 21825 00003580 89C1                    	MOV	CX,AX

 21827                                  
 21828                                  ;	(CX) = number of clusters to skip.
 21829                                  ;	(AH) = remainder
 21830                                  
 21831                                  	; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 21832

 22973                                  ;
 22974                                  ; Procedure Name : DskRdBufScan
 22975                                  ;
 22976                                  ; Inputs:
 22977                                  ;       CX = # of contiguous sectors read. (These constitute a block of
 22978                                  ;            sectors, also termed an "Extent".)
 22979                                  ;       [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX = physical sector # of first sector in extent.
 22980                                  ;       [TEMP_VAR2]:[TEMP_VAR] = Transfer address (destination data address).
 22981                                  ;       ES:BP -> Drive Parameter Block (DPB).
 22982                                  ;
 22983                                  ; Function:
 22984                                  ;	The Buffer Queue is scanned: the contents of any dirty buffers are
 22985                                  ;	"read" into the transfer memory block, so that the transfer memory
 22986                                  ;	reflects the most recent data.
 22987                                  ;
 22988                                  ; Outputs:
 22989                                  ;       Transfer memory updated as required.
 22990                                  ;
 22991                                  ; Uses:
 22992                                  ;       DS,AX,BX,CX,SI,DI destroyed.
 22993                                  ;       SS override for all global variables.
 22994                                  ;
 22995                                  ; Notes:
 22996                                  ;       FIRST_BUFF_ADDR is set-up to contain the LAST buffer to check, rather
 22997                                  ;	than the FIRST.
 22998                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 22999                                  ;M039: Created
 23000                                  
 23001                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 23002                                  ; DOSCODE:78F0h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 23003                                  
 23004                                  ; 18/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 23005                                  ; DOSCODE:78DCh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 23006                                  
 23007                                  ;procedure DskRdBufScan,NEAR
 23008                                  ;
 23009                                  ;ASSUME  DS:NOTHING
 23010                                  
 23011                                  DskRdBufScan:
 23012 0000388B 36833E[7100]00          	cmp	word [ss:DirtyBufferCount],0 ; Any dirty buffers?
 23013 00003891 743C                    	je	short bufx		     ; -no, skip all work.
 23014

 23016 00003898 89DE                    	mov     si,bx
 23017 0000389A 01D1                    	add     cx,dx
 23018 0000389C 83D600                  	adc     si,0

 23021                                  	;mov	ax,[di+2]

 23024

 23032                                  ;       SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 23033                                  ;          AL = Drive #.
 23034                                  ;       DS:DI-> 1st buffer in queue.
 23035                                  ;[FIRST_BUFF_ADDR] = Address offset of last buffer in queue.
 23036                                  
 23037                                  bufq:	
 23038                                  	;cmp	al,[di+4]

 23067 000038CD 75DE                    	jne	short bufq		; -no, do next buffer
 23068                                  bufx:
 23069 000038CF C3                      	retn				;Exit.
 23070                                  
 23071                                  ;       Buffer's sector is in Extent: if it is dirty, copy its contents to
 23072                                  ;	transfer memory; otherwise, just re-position it in the buffer queue
 23073                                  ;       as MRU (Most Recently Used).
 23074                                  
 23075                                  bufq2:	
 23076 000038D0 50                      	push	ax
 23077                                  	;test	byte [di+5],40h
 23078 000038D1 F6450540                	test	byte [di+BUFFINFO.buf_flags],buf_dirty ;Buffer dirty?

 23083 000038D8 52                      	push	dx

 23090 000038DE 2B4506                  	sub	ax,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 23091 000038E1 F7D8                    	neg	ax
 23092                                  
 23093                                  ;       AX = offset (in sectors) of buffer sector within Transfer memory
 23094                                  ;            block. (Note: the upper word of the sector # may be ignored
 23095                                  ;	     since no more than 64k bytes will ever be read. This 64k limit
 23096                                  ;            is imposed by the input parameters of the disk read operation.)

 23126                                  bufq03:
 23127                                  	;RestoreReg <es,di,si,dx,cx>
 23128 000038FA 07                      	pop	es
 23129 000038FB 5F                      	pop	di
 23130 000038FC 5E                      	pop	si
 23131 000038FD 5A                      	pop	dx

 23133                                  
 23134                                  ;       DS:DI -> current buffer.

 23881                                  ;Break   <DskWrtBufPurge -- Disk Write Buffer Purge>
 23882                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 23883                                  ;
 23884                                  ; Procedure Name : DskWrtBufPurge
 23885                                  ;
 23886                                  ; Inputs:
 23887                                  ;       CX = # of contiguous sectors to write. (These constitute a block of
 23888                                  ;	     sectors, also termed an "Extent".)
 23889                                  ;       [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX = physical sector # of first sector in extent.
 23890                                  ;       ES:BP -> Drive Parameter Block (DPB).
 23891                                  ;
 23892                                  ; Function:
 23893                                  ;       Purge the Buffer Queue and the Secondary Cache of any buffers which
 23894                                  ;	are in Extent; they are being over-written.
 23895                                  ;
 23896                                  ; Outputs:
 23897                                  ;       (Same as Input.)
 23898                                  ; Uses:
 23899                                  ;       All registers except DS,AX,SI,DI preserved.
 23900                                  ;       SS override for all global variables.
 23901                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 23902                                  ;M039: Created
 23903                                  
 23904                                  ;procedure   DskWrtBufPurge,NEAR
 23905                                  ;
 23906                                  ;ASSUME  DS:NOTHING
 23907                                  
 23908                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 23909                                  ; DOSCODE:7C0Eh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 23910                                  
 23911                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 23912                                  ; DOSCODE:7BD4h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 23913                                  
 23914                                  DskWrtBufPurge:
 23915                                  	;SaveReg <bx,cx>
 23916 00003B8F 53                      	push	bx
 23917 00003B90 51                      	push	cx
 23918                                  
 23919 00003B91 368B1E[0706]            	mov	bx,[ss:HIGH_SECTOR]	;BX:DX = Extent start (sector #).
 23920 00003B96 89DE                    	mov	si,bx
 23921 00003B98 01D1                    	add	cx,dx
 23922 00003B9A 83D600                  	adc	si,0                    ;SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 23923                                  
 23924                                  	; 21/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 23925                                  	;;mov	al,[es:bp+0]
 23926                                  	;mov	al,[es:bp+DPB.DRIVE]
 23927                                  	; 15/12/2022
 23928 00003B9D 268A4600                	mov	al,[es:bp]
 23929                                  
 23930                                  ;	BX:DX = Extent start.
 23931                                  ;	SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 23932                                  ;	AL = Drive #
 23933                                  
 23934 00003BA1 36833E[7700]00          	cmp	word [ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT],0 ;Secondary cache in-use?
 23935 00003BA7 7431                    	je	short nosc		; -no, jump.
 23936                                  
 23937                                  ;	If any of the sectors to be written are in the secondary cache (SC),
 23938                                  ;	invalidate the entire SC. (This is an optimization; we really only
 23939                                  ;	need to invalidate those sectors which intersect, but that's slower.)
 23940                                  
 23941 00003BA9 363A06[B00D]            	cmp	al,[ss:CurSC_DRIVE]	;Same drive?
 23942 00003BAE 752A                    	jne	short nosc		; -no, jump.
 23943                                  
 23944 00003BB0 50                      	push    ax
 23945 00003BB1 36A1[B10D]              	mov     ax,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR]
 23946 00003BB5 368B3E[B30D]            	mov     di,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR+2]	;DI:AX = SC start.
 23947                                  
 23948                                  	;Cmp32	si,cx,di,ax		;Extent end < SC start?
 23949                                  	;jbe	short sc5		; -yes, jump.
 23950                                  
 23951 00003BBA 39FE                    	cmp	si,di
 23952 00003BBC 7502                    	jne	short sc01
 23953 00003BBE 39C1                    	cmp	cx,ax
 23954                                  sc01: 
 23955 00003BC0 7617                    	jbe	short sc5
 23956                                  
 23957 00003BC2 360306[7700]            	add	ax,[ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT]
 23958 00003BC7 83D700                  	adc	di,0                    ;DI:AX = SC end + 1.
 23959                                  	
 23960                                  	;Cmp32	bx,dx,di,ax             ;Extent start > SC end?
 23961                                  	;jae	short sc5		; -yes, jump.
 23962                                  
 23963 00003BCA 39FB                    	cmp	bx,di
 23964 00003BCC 7502                    	jne	short sc02
 23965 00003BCE 39C2                    	cmp	dx,ax
 23966                                  sc02:
 23967 00003BD0 7307                    	jnb	short sc5
 23968                                  
 23969 00003BD2 36C706[B50D]0000        	mov	word [ss:SC_STATUS],0	;Extent intersects SC: invalidate SC.
 23970                                  sc5:	
 23971 00003BD9 58                      	pop     ax
 23972                                  
 23973                                  ;	Free any buffered sectors which are in Extent; they are being over-
 23974                                  ;	written.
 23975                                  
 23976                                  nosc:	
 23977 00003BDA E85A1B                  	call	GETCURHEAD		;DS:DI -> first buffer in queue.
 23978                                  
 23979                                  _bufq:	
 23980                                  	;cmpo	al,[di+4]
 23981 00003BDD 3A4504                  	cmp     al,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID] ;Same drive?
 23982 00003BE0 7527                    	jne	short bufq5		; -no, jump.
 23983                                  
 23984                                  ;       Cmp32   bx,dx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 23985                                  ;       ja	short bufq5		;Jump if Extent start > buffer sector.
 23986                                  
 23987                                  	;cmp	bx,[di+8]
 23988 00003BE2 3B5D08                  	cmp	bx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 23989 00003BE5 7503                    	jne	short bufq04
 23990                                  	;cmp	dx,[di+6]
 23991 00003BE7 3B5506                  	cmp	dx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 23992                                  bufq04:
 23993 00003BEA 771D                    	ja	short bufq5
 23994                                  
 23995                                  ;       Cmp32   si,cx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 23996                                  ;       jbe	short bufq5		;Jump if Extent end < buffer sector.
 23997                                  
 23998                                  	;cmp	si,[di+8]
 23999 00003BEC 3B7508                  	cmp	si,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 24000 00003BEF 7503                    	jne	short bufq05
 24001                                  	;cmp	cx,[di+6]
 24002 00003BF1 3B4D06                  	cmp	cx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 24003                                  bufq05:
 24004 00003BF4 7613                    	jbe	short bufq5
 24005                                  
 24006                                  ;	Buffer's sector is in Extent, so free it; it is being over-written.
 24007                                  
 24008                                  	;test	byte [di+5],40h
 24009 00003BF6 F6450540                	test	byte [di+BUFFINFO.buf_flags],buf_dirty ;Buffer dirty?
 24010 00003BFA 7403                    	jz	short bufq4		; -no, jump.
 24011 00003BFC E8C21D                  	call	DEC_DIRTY_COUNT		; -yes, decrement dirty count.
 24012                                  bufq4:
 24013                                  	;mov	word [di+4],20FFh
 24014 00003BFF C74504FF20              	mov     word [di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID],((buf_visit<<8)|0FFh)
 24015                                  
 24016 00003C04 E8421B                  	call	SCANPLACE
 24017 00003C07 EB02                    	jmp     short bufq6
 24018                                  bufq5: 
 24019 00003C09 8B3D                    	mov     di,[di]
 24020                                  	;mov	di,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_next]
 24021                                  bufq6: 
 24022 00003C0B 363B3E[BB0E]            	cmp	di,[ss:FIRST_BUFF_ADDR]	;Scanned entire buffer queue?
 24023 00003C10 75CB                    	jne	short _bufq		; --no, go do next buffer.
 24024                                  	
 24025                                  	;RestoreReg <cx,bx>
 24026 00003C12 59                      	pop	cx
 24027 00003C13 5B                      	pop	bx
 24028 00003C14 C3                      	retn
 24029                                  
 24030                                  ;EndProc DskWrtBufPurge
 24031                                  
 24032                                  ;Break   <DIV32 -- PERFORM 32 BIT DIVIDE>
 24033                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24034                                  ;
 24035                                  ; Procedure Name : DIV32
 24036                                  ;
 24037                                  ; Inputs:
 24038                                  ;       DX:AX = 32 bit dividend   BX= divisor
 24039                                  ; Function:
 24040                                  ;       Perform 32 bit division:  DX:AX/BX = CX:AX + DX (rem.)
 24041                                  ; Outputs:
 24042                                  ;       CX:AX = quotient , DX= remainder
 24043                                  ; Uses:
 24044                                  ;       All registers except AX,CX,DX preserved.
 24045                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24046                                  ;M039: DIV32 optimized for divisor of 512 (common sector size).
 24047                                  
 24048                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 24049                                  ; DOSCODE:7C94h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 24050                                  
 24051                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24052                                  ; DOSCODE:7C5Ah (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 24053                                  
 24054                                  DIV32:
 24055 00003C15 81FB0002                	cmp	bx,512
 24056 00003C19 7515                    	jne	short div5
 24057                                  
 24058 00003C1B 89D1                    	mov	cx,dx
 24059 00003C1D 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax           ; CX:AX = Dividend
 24060 00003C1F 81E2FF01                	and	dx,(512-1)      ; DX = Remainder
 24061 00003C23 88E0                    	mov	al,ah
 24062 00003C25 88CC                    	mov	ah,cl
 24063 00003C27 88E9                    	mov	cl,ch
 24064 00003C29 30ED                    	xor	ch,ch
 24065 00003C2B D1E9                    	shr	cx,1
 24066 00003C2D D1D8                    	rcr	ax,1
 24067 00003C2F C3                      	retn
 24068                                  div5:	
 24069 00003C30 89C1                    	mov	cx,ax
 24070 00003C32 89D0                    	mov	ax,dx
 24071 00003C34 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx
 24072 00003C36 F7F3                    	div	bx              ; 0:AX/BX
 24073 00003C38 91                      	xchg	cx,ax
 24074 00003C39 F7F3                    	div	bx              ; DX:AX/BX
 24075 00003C3B C3                      	retn
 24076                                  
 24077                                  ;Break   <SHR32 -- PERFORM 32 BIT SHIFT RIGHT>
 24078                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24079                                  ;
 24080                                  ; Procedure Name : SHR32
 24081                                  ;
 24082                                  ; Inputs:
 24083                                  ;	DX:AX = 32 bit sector number
 24084                                  ; Function:
 24085                                  ;       Perform 32 bit shift right
 24086                                  ; Outputs:
 24087                                  ;	AX = cluster number
 24088                                  ;	ZF = 1 if no error
 24089                                  ;	   = 0 if error (cluster number > 64k)
 24090                                  ; Uses:
 24091                                  ;       DX,CX
 24092                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24093                                  ; M017	- SHR32 rewritten for better performance
 24094                                  ; M039	- Additional optimization
 24095                                  
 24096                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 24097                                  ; DOSCODE:7CBBh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 24098                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24099                                  ; DOSCODE:7C81h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 24100                                  
 24101                                  SHR32:
 24102                                  	;mov	cl,[es:bp+5]
 24103 00003C3C 268A4E05                	mov	cl,[ES:BP+DPB.CLUSTER_SHIFT]
 24104 00003C40 30ED                    	xor	ch,ch	    ;ZF=1
 24105 00003C42 E306                    	jcxz	norota
 24106                                  
 24107                                  rotashft2:
 24108 00003C44 D1EA                    	shr	dx,1	    ;ZF reflects state of DX.
 24109 00003C46 D1D8                    	rcr	ax,1	    ;ZF not affected.
 24110 00003C48 E2FA                    	loop	rotashft2
 24111                                  norota:
 24112 00003C4A C3                      	retn
 24113

 24120                                  ;	TITLE	DIR - Directory and path cracking
 24121                                  ;	NAME	Dir
 24122                                  
 24123                                  ;Break	<FINDENTRY -- LOOK FOR AN ENTRY>
 24124                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24125                                  ;
 24126                                  ; Procedure Name : FINDENTRY,SEARCH
 24127                                  ;
 24128                                  ; Inputs:
 24129                                  ;	[THISDPB] set
 24130                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] = 0
 24131                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = Starting directory sector number
 24132                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Next cluster of directory
 24133                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors/Cluster
 24134                                  ;	[NAME1] = Name to look for
 24135                                  ; Function:
 24136                                  ;	Find file name in disk directory.
 24137                                  ;	"?" matches any character.
 24138                                  ; Outputs:
 24139                                  ;	Carry set if name not found
 24140                                  ;	ELSE
 24141                                  ;	Zero set if attributes match (always except when creating)
 24142                                  ;	AH = Device ID (bit 7 set if not disk)
 24143                                  ;	[THISDPB] = Base of drive parameters
 24144                                  ;	DS = DOSGROUP
 24145                                  ;	ES = DOSGROUP
 24146                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:BX = Pointer into directory buffer
 24147                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:SI = Pointer to First Cluster field in directory entry
 24148                                  ;	[CURBUF] has directory record with match
 24149                                  ;	[NAME1] has file name
 24150                                  ;	[LASTENT] is entry number of the entry
 24151                                  ; All other registers destroyed.
 24152                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24153                                  
 24154                                  ;hkn; called from rename.asm and dir2.asm. DS must be already set up at
 24155                                  ;hkn; this point.
 24156                                  
 24157                                  SEARCH:
 24158                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
