 24314                                  ; Procedure Name : MetaCompare
 24315                                  ;
 24316                                  ; Inputs:
 24317                                  ;	DS:SI -> 11 character FCB style name NO '?'
 24318                                  ;	    Typically this is a directory entry. It MUST be in upper case
 24319                                  ;	ES:DI -> 11 character FCB style name with possible '?'
 24320                                  ;	    Typically this is a FCB or SFT. It MUST be in upper case
 24321                                  ; Function:
 24322                                  ;	Compare FCB style names allowing for ? match to any char
 24323                                  ; Outputs:
 24324                                  ;	Zero if match else NZ
 24325                                  ; Destroys CX,SI,DI all others preserved
 24326                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24327                                  
 24328                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)

 24453                                  ;
 24454                                  ; Procedure Name : GETENTRY
 24455                                  ;
 24456                                  ; Inputs:
 24457                                  ;	[LASTENT] has directory entry
 24458                                  ;	ES:BP points to drive parameters
 24459                                  ;	[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[ENTLAST] set for DIR involved
 24460                                  ; Function:
 24461                                  ;	Locates directory entry in preparation for search
 24462                                  ;	GETENT provides entry for passing desired entry in AX
 24463                                  ; Outputs:
 24464                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:BX = Pointer to next directory entry in CURBUF
 24465                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:DX = Pointer to first byte after end of CURBUF
 24466                                  ;	[LASTENT] = New directory entry number
 24467                                  ;	[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS] set via DIRREAD
 24468                                  ;	Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)

 24470                                  
 24471                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24472                                  GETENTRY:
 24473                                  	; 27/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 24474 00003D55 A1[4803]                	MOV	AX,[LASTENT]
 24475                                  
 24476                                  	;entry	GETENT
 24477                                  GETENT:
 24478 00003D58 A3[4803]                	MOV	[LASTENT],AX
 24479                                  ;
 24480                                  ; Convert the entry number in AX into a byte offset from the beginning of the
 24481                                  ; directory.
 24482                                  ;
 24483 00003D5B B105                    	mov	cl,5			; shift left by 5 = mult by 32
 24484 00003D5D D3C0                    	rol	ax,cl			; keep hight order bits
 24485 00003D5F 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax
 24486                                  	; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 24487                                  	;and	ax,0FFE0h
 24488                                  	; 21/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 24489                                  	;and	ax,~(32-1)		; mask off high order bits
 24490                                  	; 16/12/2022
 24491 00003D61 24E0                    	and	al,0E0h ; ~31
 24492 00003D63 83E21F                  	and	dx,1Fh
 24493                                  	;and	dx,32-1			; mask off low order bits
 24494                                  ;
 24495                                  ; DX:AX contain the byte offset of the required directory entry from the
 24496                                  ; beginning of the directory. Convert this to a sector number. Round the
 24497                                  ; sector size down to a multiple of 32.
 24498                                  ;

 24500 00003D66 268B5E02                	MOV	BX,[ES:BP+DPB.SECTOR_SIZE]
 24501 00003D6A 80E3E0                  	and	bl,0E0h
 24502                                  	;AND	BL,255-31		; Must be multiple of 32

 24504                                  	; 14/02/2024

 24631                                  ; DIR2.ASM, MSDOS 6.0, 1991

 24633                                  ; 27/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0

 24636                                  ;	TITLE	DIR2 - Directory and path cracking
 24637                                  ;	NAME	Dir2
 24638                                  
 24639                                  ;Break	<GETPATH -- PARSE A WFP>
 24640                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24641                                  ;
 24642                                  ; Procedure Name : GETPATH
 24643                                  ;
 24644                                  ; Inputs:
 24645                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:\" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 24646                                  ;		terminated; d:/ (note forward slash) indicates a real device).
 24647                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 24648                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 24649                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 24650                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 24651                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 24652                                  ;	[NoSetDir] set
 24653                                  ;	[THISDPB] set to DPB if disk otherwise garbage.
 24654                                  ; Function:
 24655                                  ;	Crack the path
 24656                                  ; Outputs:
 24657                                  ;	Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Disk if disk file
 24658                                  ;	Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Unk if char device
 24659                                  ;	ID1 field of [THISCDS] updated appropriately
 24660                                  ;	[ATTRIB] = [SATTRIB]
 24661                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 24662                                  ;	Carry set if bad path
 24663                                  ;	   SI Points to path element causing failure
 24664                                  ;	   Zero set
 24665                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC] are set up to
 24666                                  ;	      start a search on the last directory
 24667                                  ;	      CL is zero if there is a bad name in the path
 24668                                  ;	      CL is non-zero if the name was simply not found
 24669                                  ;		 [ENTFREE] may have free spot in directory
 24670                                  ;		 [NAME1] is the name.
 24671                                  ;		 CL = 81H if '*'s or '?' in NAME1, 80H otherwise
 24672                                  ;	   Zero reset
 24673                                  ;	      File in middle of path or bad name in path or attribute mismatch
 24674                                  ;		or path too long or malformed path
 24675                                  ;	ELSE
 24676                                  ;	   [CurBuf] = -1 if root directory
 24677                                  ;	   [CURBUF] contains directory record with match
 24678                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:BX Points into [CURBUF] to start of entry
 24679                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:SI Points into [CURBUF] to dir_first field for entry
 24680                                  ;	   AH = device ID
 24681                                  ;	      bit 7 of AH set if device SI and BX
 24682                                  ;	      will point DOSGROUP relative The firclus
 24683                                  ;	      field of the device entry contains the device pointer
 24684                                  ;	   [NAME1] Has name looked for
 24685                                  ;	   If last element is a directory zero is set and:
 24686                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[SECCLUSPOS],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC]
 24687                                  ;	      are set up to start a search on it.
 24688                                  ;	      unless [NoSetDir] is non zero in which case the return is
 24689                                  ;	      like that for a file (except for zero flag)
 24690                                  ;	   If last element is a file zero is reset
 24691                                  ;	      [DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS],
 24692                                  ;	      [LASTENT], [ENTLAST] are set to continue search of last
 24693                                  ;	      directory for furthur matches on NAME1 via the NEXTENT
 24694                                  ;	      entry point in FindEntry (or GETENT entry in GETENTRY in
 24695                                  ;	      which case [NXTCLUSNUM] and [SECCLUSPOS] need not be valid)
 24696                                  ; DS preserved, Others destroyed
 24697                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24698                                  
 24699                                  ;hkn; called from delete.asm, finfo.asm, mknode.asm and rename.asm.
 24700                                  ;hkn; DS already set up at this point.
 24701                                  
 24702                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)

 24740                                  					; "finding" a char device
 24741                                  					; set LOCUS to Unknown. This makes
 24742                                  					; certain idiotic problems reported
 24743                                  					; by a certain 3 letter OEM go away.
 24744                                  
 24745                                  ; Take name in name1 and pack it back into where wfp_start points. This

 24952                                  ;Break	<ROOTPATH, FINDPATH -- PARSE A PATH>
 24953                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24954                                  ;
 24955                                  ; Procedure Name : ROOTPATH,FINDPATH
 24956                                  ;
 24957                                  ; Inputs:
 24958                                  ;	Same as FINDPATH but,
 24959                                  ;	SI Points to asciz string of path which is assumed to start at
 24960                                  ;		the root (no leading '/').
 24961                                  ; Function:
 24962                                  ;	Search from root for path
 24963                                  ; Outputs:
 24964                                  ;	Same as FINDPATH but:
 24965                                  ;	If root directory specified, [CURBUF] and [NAME1] are NOT set, and
 24966                                  ;	[NoSetDir] is ignored.
 24967                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24968                                  
 24969                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24970                                  	; DOSCODE:7F47h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 24971                                  
 24972                                  ROOTPATH:
 24973 00003ECC E8F1FE                  	call	SETROOTSRCH
 24974                                  	; 24/09/2023
 24975 00003ECF 30E4                    	xor	ah,ah
 24976                                  	;CMP	BYTE [SI],0
 24977 00003ED1 3824                    	cmp	[si],ah ; 0
 24978 00003ED3 7507                    	JNZ	short FINDPATH
 24979                                  
 24980                                  ; Root dir specified
 24981 00003ED5 A0[6D05]                	MOV	AL,[SATTRIB]
 24982 00003ED8 A2[6B05]                	MOV	[ATTRIB],AL
 24983                                  	; 24/09/2023
 24984                                  	;XOR	AH,AH			; Sets "device ID" byte, sets zero
 24985                                  					; (dir), clears carry.
 24986 00003EDB C3                      	retn
 24987                                  
 24988                                  ; Inputs:
 24989                                  ;	[ATTRIB] Set to get through directories
 24990                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Set to find last element
 24991                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 24992                                  ;	SI Points to asciz string of path (no leading '/').
 24993                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] = 0
 24994                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = Phys sec # of first sector of directory
 24995                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Cluster # of next cluster
 24996                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors per cluster
 24997                                  ;	[NoSetDir] set
 24998                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 24999                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 25000                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 25001                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 25002                                  ;	[CREATING] and [DELALL] set
 25003                                  ; Function:
 25004                                  ;	Parse path name
 25005                                  ; Outputs:
 25006                                  ;	ID1 field of [THISCDS] updated appropriately
 25007                                  ;	[ATTRIB] = [SATTRIB]
 25008                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 25009                                  ;	[THISDPB] = ES:BP
 25010                                  ;	Carry set if bad path
 25011                                  ;	   SI Points to path element causing failure
 25012                                  ;	   Zero set
 25013                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC] are set up to
 25014                                  ;	      start a search on the last directory
 25015                                  ;	      CL is zero if there is a bad name in the path
 25016                                  ;	      CL is non-zero if the name was simply not found
 25017                                  ;		 [ENTFREE] may have free spot in directory
 25018                                  ;		 [NAME1] is the name.
 25019                                  ;		 CL = 81H if '*'s or '?' in NAME1, 80H otherwise
 25020                                  ;	   Zero reset
 25021                                  ;	      File in middle of path or bad name in path
 25022                                  ;		or path too long or malformed path
 25023                                  ;	ELSE
 25024                                  ;	   [CURBUF] contains directory record with match
 25025                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:BX Points into [CURBUF] to start of entry
 25026                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:SI Points to fcb_FIRCLUS field for entry
 25027                                  ;	   [NAME1] Has name looked for
 25028                                  ;	   AH = device ID
 25029                                  ;	      bit 7 of AH set if device SI and BX
 25030                                  ;	      will point DOSGROUP relative The firclus
 25031                                  ;	      field of the device entry contains the device pointer
 25032                                  ;	   If last element is a directory zero is set and:
 25033                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[SECCLUSPOS],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC]
 25034                                  ;	      are set up to start a search on it,
 25035                                  ;	      unless [NoSetDir] is non zero in which case the return is
 25036                                  ;	      like that for a file (except for zero flag)
 25037                                  ;	   If last element is a file zero is reset
 25038                                  ;	      [DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS],
 25039                                  ;	      [LASTENT], [ENTLAST] are set to continue search of last
 25040                                  ;	      directory for furthur matches on NAME1 via the NEXTENT
 25041                                  ;	      entry point in FindEntry (or GETENT entry in GETENTRY in
 25042                                  ;	      which case [NXTCLUSNUM] and [SECCLUSPOS] need not be valid)
 25043                                  ; Destroys all other registers
 25044                                  
 25045                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 25046                                  	; DOSCODE:7F58h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 25047                                  
 25048                                  	; 15/02/2024 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS)
 25049                                  	; DOSCODE:7F93h (MSDOS 6.22, MSDOS.SYS)
 25050                                  
 25051                                      	;entry	FINDPATH
 25052                                  FINDPATH:
 25053 00003EDC 06                      	PUSH	ES			; Save ES:BP
 25054 00003EDD 56                      	PUSH	SI
 25055 00003EDE 89F7                    	MOV	DI,SI
 25056 00003EE0 8B0E[C205]              	MOV	CX,[DIRSTART]		; Get start clus of dir being searched
 25057 00003EE4 833E[B605]FF            	CMP	word [CURR_DIR_END],-1
 25058 00003EE9 740E                    	JZ	short NOIDS		; No current dir part
 25059 00003EEB 3B3E[B605]              	CMP	DI,[CURR_DIR_END]
 25060 00003EEF 7508                    	JNZ	short NOIDS		; Not to current dir end yet
 25061 00003EF1 C43E[A205]              	LES	DI,[THISCDS]
 25062                                  	;mov	[es:di+73],cx
 25063 00003EF5 26894D49                	MOV	[ES:DI+curdir.ID],CX	; Set current directory cluster
 25064                                  NOIDS:
 25065                                  
 25066                                  ; Parse the name off of DS:SI into NAME1. AL = 1 if there was a meta
 25067                                  ; character in the string. CX,DI may be destroyed.
 25068                                  ;
 25069                                  ;	invoke	NAMETRANS
 25070                                  ;	MOV	CL,AL
 25071                                  ;
 25072                                  ; The above is the slow method. The name has *already* been munged by
 25073                                  ; TransPath so no special casing needs to be done. All we do is try to copy
 25074                                  ; the name until ., \ or 0 is hit.
 25075                                  
 25076                                  	;MOV	AX,SS
 25077                                  	;MOV	ES,AX
 25078                                  	; 15/02/2024 - Retro DOS v4.2
 25079 00003EF9 16                      	push	ss
 25080 00003EFA 07                      	pop	es
 25081                                  
 25082                                  ;hkn; Name1 is in DOSDATA
 25083 00003EFB BF[4B05]                	MOV	DI,NAME1
 25084 00003EFE B82020                  	MOV	AX,'  ' ; 2020h
 25085 00003F01 AA                      	STOSB

 25087 00003F03 AB                      	STOSW
 25088 00003F04 AB                      	STOSW
 25089 00003F05 AB                      	STOSW
 25090 00003F06 AB                      	STOSW
 25091                                  
 25092                                  ;hkn; Name1 is in DOSDATA

 25794                                  ;Break	<CheckThisDevice - Check for being a device>
 25795                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 25796                                  ;
 25797                                  ;   CheckThisDevice - Examine the area at DS:SI to see if there is a valid
 25798                                  ;   device specified. We will return carry if there is a device present. 
 25799                                  ;   The forms of devices we will recognize are:
 25800                                  ;
 25801                                  ;	[path]device
 25802                                  ;
 25803                                  ;   Note that the drive letter has *already* been removed. All other forms
 25804                                  ;   are not considered to be devices. If such a device is found we change
 25805                                  ;   the source pointer to point to the device component.
 25806                                  ;
 25807                                  ;   Inputs:	ES is DOSDATA
 25808                                  ;		DS:SI contains name
 25809                                  ;   Outputs:	ES is DOSDATA

 25838 000041D7 7526                    	JNZ	short NotDevice
 25839 000041D9 AC                      	LODSB

 25841 000041DD 7520                    	JNZ	short NotDevice		; no. go for it.

 26196                                  ; Procedure Name : IOFUNC

 26198                                  ; Inputs:
 26199                                  ;	DS:SI Points to SFT

 26201                                  ;		= 0 Input
 26202                                  ;		= 1 Input Status
 26203                                  ;		= 2 Output

 26210                                  ;	Perform indicated I/O to device or file

 26212                                  ;	AL is character if input

 26214                                  ;		zero set if not ready
 26215                                  ;		zero reset if ready (character in AL for input status)
 26216                                  ; For regular files:
 26217                                  ;	Input Status

 26222                                  ;		Returns ^Z on EOF

 27432                                  ;
 27433                                  ; Procedure Name : MakeNode
 27434                                  ;
 27435                                  ; Inputs:
 27436                                  ;       AL - attribute to create
 27437                                  ;       AH = 0 if it is ok to truncate a file already by this name
 27438                                  ;	AH != 0 if truncation not allowed (prexisting file is an error)
 27439                                  ;               (AH ignored on dirs and devices)
 27440                                  ;
 27441                                  ;        NOTE: When making a DIR or volume ID, AH need not be set since
 27442                                  ;               a name already existant is ALWAYS an error in these cases.
 27443                                  ;
 27444                                  ;       [WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 27445                                  ;               terminated)
 27446                                  ;       [CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 27447                                  ;               ( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 27448                                  ;                Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 27449                                  ;       [THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 27450                                  ;       [THISSFT] Points to an empty SFT. EXCEPT sf_mode filled in.
 27451                                  ; Function:
 27452                                  ;       Make a new node
 27453                                  ; Outputs:
 27454                                  ;       Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Disk or errLOC_Unk via GetPathNoset
 27455                                  ;       CARRY SET IF ERROR
 27456                                  ;          AX = 1 A node by this name exists and is a directory
 27457                                  ;          AX = 2 A new node could not be created
 27458                                  ;          AX = 3 A node by this name exists and is a disk file
 27459                                  ;               (AH was NZ on input)
 27460                                  ;          AX = 4 Bad Path
 27461                                  ;               SI return from GetPath maintained
 27462                                  ;          AX = 5 Attribute mismatch
 27463                                  ;          AX = 6 Sharing Violation
 27464                                  ;               (INT 24 generated ALWAYS since create is always compat mode
 27465                                  ;          AX = 7 file not found for Extended Open (not exists and fails)
 27466                                  ;       ELSE
 27467                                  ;          AX = 0 Disk Node
 27468                                  ;          AX = 3 Device Node (error in some cases)
 27469                                  ;          [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSFAC],[CLUSNUM] set to directory
 27470                                  ;               containing new node.
 27471                                  ;          [CURBUF+2]:BX Points to entry
 27472                                  ;          [CURBUF+2]:SI Points to entry.dir_first
 27473                                  ;          [THISSFT] is filled in
 27474                                  ;               sf_mode = unchanged.
 27475                                  ;          Attribute byte in entry is input AL
 27476                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 27477                                  ;
 27478                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27479                                  
 27480                                  ; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 27481                                  ; DOSCODE:8925h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 27482                                  
 27483                                  ; 22/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27484                                  ; DOSCODE:88EAh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 27485                                  
 27486                                  ; 23/02/2024 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS)
 27487                                  ; DOSCODE:8925h (MSDOS 6.22, MSDOS.SYS)
 27488                                  ; DOSCODE:951Ah (PCDOS 7.1, IBMDOS.COM)

 27669                                  
 27670                                  ; We have found an existing file. We have also entered it into the share set.
 27671                                  ; At this point we need to call newentry to correctly address the problem of
 27672                                  ; getting rid of old data (create an existing file) or creating a new
 27673                                  ; directory entry (create a new file). Unfortunately, this operation may
 27674                                  ; result in an INT 24 that the user doesn't return from, thus locking the file
 27675                                  ; irretrievably into the share set. The correct solution is for us to LEAVE
 27676                                  ; the share set now, do the operation and then reassert the share access.
 27677                                  ;
 27678                                  ; We are allowed to do this! There is no window! After all, we are in
 27679                                  ; critDisk here and for someone else to get in, they must enter critDisk also.
 27680                                  
 27681                                  	; 22/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27682                                  	; DOSCODE:89C8h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 27728                                  ;
 27729                                  ; Procedure Name : NEWENTRY
 27730                                  ;
 27731                                  ; Inputs:
 27732                                  ;	  [THISSFT] set
 27733                                  ;	  [THISDPB] set
 27734                                  ;	  [LASTENT] current last valid entry number in directory if no free
 27735                                  ;		  entries
 27736                                  ;	  [VOLID] set if a volume ID was found during search
 27737                                  ;	Attrib Contains attributes for new file
 27738                                  ;	  [DIRSTART] Points to first cluster of dir (0 means root)
 27739                                  ;	  CARRY FLAG INDICATES STATUS OF SEARCH FOR FILE
 27740                                  ;		  NC means file existed (device)
 27741                                  ;		  C  means file did not exist
 27742                                  ;	  AH = Device ID byte
 27743                                  ;	  If FILE
 27744                                  ;	  [CURBUF+2]:BX points to start of directory entry
 27745                                  ;	  [CURBUF+2]:SI points to dir_first of directory entry
 27746                                  ;	  If device
 27747                                  ;	  DS:BX points to start of "fake" directory entry
 27748                                  ;	  DS:SI points to dir_first of "fake" directory entry
 27749                                  ;		  (has DWORD pointer to device header)
 27750                                  ; Function:
 27751                                  ;	  Make a new directory entry
 27752                                  ;	  If an old one existed it is truncated first
 27753                                  ; Outputs:
 27754                                  ;	  Carry set if error
 27755                                  ;		  Can't grow dir, atts didn't match, attempt to make 2nd
 27756                                  ;		  vol ID, user FAILed to I 24
 27757                                  ;	  else
 27758                                  ;		  outputs of DOOPEN
 27759                                  ; DS, BX, SI preserved (meaning on SI BX, not value), others destroyed
 27760                                  ;
 27761                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27762                                  
 27763                                  	; 22/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27764                                  	; DOSCODE:89F9h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 27765

 28207                                  ; Procedure Name : CHECK_VIRT_OPEN
 28208                                  ;
 28209                                  ; CHECK_VIRT_OPEN checks to see if we had performed a "virtual open" (by
 28210                                  ; examining the flag [VIRTUAL_OPEN] to see if it is 1). If we did, then
 28211                                  ; it calls Dev_Close_SFT to decrement the ref. count. It also resets the
 28212                                  ; flag [VIRTUAL_OPEN].
 28213                                  ; No registers affected (including flags).
 28214                                  ; On input, [THISSFT] points to current SFT.
 28215                                  ;
 28216                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28217                                  
 28218                                  CHECK_VIRT_OPEN:
 28219 00004AAD 50                      	PUSH	AX
 28220 00004AAE 9F                      	lahf			; preserve flags
 28221 00004AAF 803E[A20A]00            	CMP	byte [VIRTUAL_OPEN],0
 28222 00004AB4 7410                    	JZ	short ALL_CLOSED
 28223 00004AB6 C606[A20A]00            	mov	byte [VIRTUAL_OPEN],0 ; reset flag
 28224 00004ABB 06                      	push	es
 28225 00004ABC 57                      	push	di
 28226 00004ABD C43E[9E05]              	LES	DI,[THISSFT]
 28227 00004AC1 E8C9F9                  	call	DEV_CLOSE_SFT
 28228 00004AC4 5F                      	pop	di
 28229 00004AC5 07                      	pop	es
 28230                                  
 28231                                  ALL_CLOSED:
 28232 00004AC6 9E                      	sahf			; restore flags
 28233 00004AC7 58                      	POP	AX
 28234 00004AC8 C3                      	retn

 28270                                  ; Procedure Name : FNDCLUS
 28271                                  ;
 28272                                  ; Inputs:

 28353                                  ;Break  <BUFSEC -- BUFFER A SECTOR AND SET UP A TRANSFER>

 28825                                  ; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 28826                                  ; DOSCODE:8DC2h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 28827                                  
 28828                                  ; 30/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 28829                                  ; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3, 1987) - Offset 
 28830                                  
 28831                                  ;Break   <ALLOCATE -- Assign disk space>
 28832                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28833                                  ;
 28834                                  ; Procedure Name : ALLOCATE - Allocate Disk Space
 28835                                  ;
 28836                                  ;   ALLOCATE is called to allocate disk clusters. The new clusters are
 28837                                  ;   FAT-chained onto the end of the existing file.
 28838                                  ;
 28839                                  ;   The DPB contains the cluster # of the last free cluster allocated
 28840                                  ;   (dpb_next_free). We start at this cluster and scan towards higher
 28841                                  ;   numbered clusters, looking for the necessary free blocks.
 28842                                  ;
 28843                                  ;   Once again, fancy terminology gets in the way of correct coding. When
 28844                                  ;   using next_free, start scanning AT THAT POINT and not the one following it.
 28845                                  ;   This fixes the boundary condition bug when only free = next_free = 2.
 28846                                  ;
 28847                                  ;       If we get to the end of the disk without satisfaction:
 28848                                  ;
 28849                                  ;           if (dpb_next_free == 2) then we've scanned the whole disk.
 28850                                  ;               return (insufficient_disk_space)
 28851                                  ;           ELSE
 28852                                  ;               dpb_next_free = 2; start scan over from the beginning.
 28853                                  ;
 28854                                  ;   Note that there is no multitasking interlock. There is no race when
 28855                                  ;   examining the entrys in an in-core FAT block since there will be no
 28856                                  ;   context switch. When UNPACK context switches while waiting for a FAT read
 28857                                  ;   we are done with any in-core FAT blocks, so again there is no race. The
 28858                                  ;   only special concern is that V2 and V3 MSDOS left the last allocated
 28859                                  ;   cluster as "00"; marking it EOF only when the entire alloc request was
 28860                                  ;   satisfied. We can't allow another activation to think this cluster is
 28861                                  ;   free, so we give it a special temporary mark to show that it is, indeed,
 28862                                  ;   allocated.
 28863                                  ;
 28864                                  ;   Note that when we run out of space this algorithem will scan from
 28865                                  ;   dpb_next_free to the end, then scan from cluster 2 through the end,
 28866                                  ;   redundantly scanning the later part of the disk. This only happens when
 28867                                  ;   we run out of space, so sue me.
 28868                                  ;
 28869                                  ;----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----;
 28870                                  ;            C  A  V  E  A  T     P  A  T  T  E  R  S  O  N                ;
 28871                                  ;                                                                          ;
 28872                                  ;   The use of FATBYT and RESTFATBYT is somewhat mysterious. Here is the
 28873                                  ;   explanation:
 28874                                  ;
 28875                                  ;   In the NUL file case (sf_firclus currently 0) ALLOCATE is called with
 28876                                  ;   entry BX = 0. What needs to be done in this case is to stuff the cluster
 28877                                  ;   number of the first cluster allocated in sf_firclus when the ALLOCATE is
 28878                                  ;   complete. THIS VALUE IS SAVED TEMPORARILY IN CLUSTER 0, HENCE THE CURRENT
 28879                                  ;   VALUE IN CLUSTER 0 MUST BE SAVED AND RESTORED. This is a side effect of
 28880                                  ;   the fact that PACK and UNPACK don't treat requests for clusters 0 and 1 as
 28881                                  ;   errors. This "stuff" is done by the call to PACK which is right before
 28882                                  ;   the
 28883                                  ;           LOOP   findfre         ; alloc more if needed
 28884                                  ;   instruction when the first cluster is allocated to the nul file. The
 28885                                  ;   value is recalled from cluster 0 and stored at sf_firclus at ads4:
 28886                                  ;
 28887                                  ;   This method is obviously useless (because it is non-reentrant) for
 28888                                  ;   multitasking, and will have to be changed. Storing the required value on
 28889                                  ;   the stack is recommended. Setting sf_firclus at the PACK of cluster 0
 28890                                  ;   (instead of actually doing the PACK) is BAD because it doesn't handle
 28891                                  ;   problems with INT 24 well.
 28892                                  ;
 28893                                  ;            C  A  V  E  A  T     P  A  T  T  E  R  S  O  N                ;
 28894                                  ;----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----;
 28895                                  ;                                                                          ;
 28896                                  ;       ENTRY   BX = Last cluster of file (0 if null file)
 28897                                  ;               CX = No. of clusters to allocate
 28898                                  ;               ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 28899                                  ;               [THISSFT] = Points to SFT
 28900                                  ;
 28901                                  ;       EXIT    'C' set if insufficient space
 28902                                  ;                 [FAILERR] can be tested to see the reason for failure
 28903                                  ;                 CX = max. no. of clusters that could be added to file
 28904                                  ;               'C' clear if space allocated
 28905                                  ;                 BX = First cluster allocated
 28906                                  ;                 FAT is fully updated
 28907                                  ;                 sf_FIRCLUS field of SFT set if file was null
 28908                                  ;
 28909                                  ;       USES    ALL but SI, BP
 28910                                  
 28911                                  ;callmagic  proc near
 28912                                  ;       push    ds                             ;push segment of routine 
 28913                                  ;       push    Offset MagicPatch              ;push offset for routine
 28914                                  ;       retf                                   ;simulate jmp far
 28915                                  ;                                              ;far return address is on
 28916                                  ;                                              ;stack, so far return from
 28917                                  ;                                              ;call will return this routine
 28918                                  ;callmagic  endp
 28919                                  
 28920                                  
 28921                                  ; 25/09/2023

 28926                                  	retf	
 28927                                  %endif
 28928

 29231                                  ;Break	<GETEOF -- Find the end of a file>
 29232                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29233                                  ;
 29234                                  ; Procedure Name : GETEOF
 29235                                  ;
 29236                                  ; Inputs:
 29237                                  ;       ES:BP Points to DPB
 29238                                  ;       BX = Cluster in a file
 29239                                  ;       DS = CS
 29240                                  ; Outputs:
 29241                                  ;       BX = Last cluster in the file
 29242                                  ;       Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 29243                                  ; DI destroyed. No other registers affected.
 29244                                  ;

 29300                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 29301                                  	; DOSCODE:8E77h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 29302                                  
 29303                                  	; 29/02/2024 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS)
 29304                                  	; (MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:8ED3h)
 29305                                  MAKEFCB:
 29306                                  ;hkn; SS override
 29307                                  	;MOV	BYTE [SS:SpaceFlag],0
 29308 00004D83 30D2                    	XOR	DL,DL		; Flag--not ambiguous file name
 29309                                  	; 29/02/2024
 29310 00004D85 368816[4E03]            	mov	[ss:SpaceFlag],dl ; 0
 29311                                  	;test	al,2
 29312 00004D8A A802                    	test	AL,DRVBIT	; Use current drive field if default?
 29313 00004D8C 7503                    	JNZ	short DEFDRV
 29314                                  	;MOV	BYTE [ES:DI],0	; No - use default drive
 29315                                  	; 29/02/2024
 29316 00004D8E 268815                  	mov	[es:di],dl ; 0
 29317                                  DEFDRV:
 29318 00004D91 47                      	INC	DI
 29319 00004D92 B90800                  	MOV	CX,8
 29320                                  	;test	al,4
 29321 00004D95 A804                    	test	AL,NAMBIT	; Use current name fields as default?
 29322 00004D97 93                      	XCHG	AX,BX		; Save bits in BX
 29323 00004D98 B020                    	MOV	AL," "
 29324 00004D9A 7404                    	JZ	short FILLB	; If not, go fill with blanks
 29325 00004D9C 01CF                    	ADD	DI,CX
 29326 00004D9E 31C9                    	XOR	CX,CX		; Don't fill any
 29327                                  FILLB:
 29328 00004DA0 F3AA                    	REP	STOSB
 29329 00004DA2 B103                    	MOV	CL,3
 29330 00004DA4 F6C308                  	test	BL,EXTBIT	; Use current extension as default
 29331 00004DA7 7404                    	JZ	short FILLB2
 29332 00004DA9 01CF                    	ADD	DI,CX
 29333 00004DAB 31C9                    	XOR	CX,CX
 29334                                  FILLB2:
 29335 00004DAD F3AA                    	REP	STOSB
 29336 00004DAF 91                      	XCHG	AX,CX		; Put zero in AX
 29337 00004DB0 AB                      	STOSW
 29338 00004DB1 AB                      	STOSW			; Initialize two words after to zero
 29339 00004DB2 83EF10                  	SUB	DI,16		; Point back at start
 29340                                  	;test	bl,1
 29341 00004DB5 F6C301                  	test	BL,SCANSEPARATOR; Scan off separators if not zero
 29342 00004DB8 7409                    	JZ	short SKPSPC
 29343 00004DBA E88800                  	CALL	SCANB		; Peel off blanks and tabs
 29344 00004DBD E81E01                  	CALL	DELIM		; Is it a one-time-only delimiter?
 29345 00004DC0 7504                    	JNZ	short NOSCAN
 29346 00004DC2 46                      	INC	SI		; Skip over the delimiter
 29347                                  SKPSPC:
 29348 00004DC3 E87F00                  	CALL	SCANB		; Always kill preceding blanks and tabs
 29349                                  NOSCAN:
 29350 00004DC6 E8EC00                  	CALL	GETLET
 29351 00004DC9 761E                    	JBE	short NODRV	; Quit if termination character
 29352 00004DCB 803C3A                  	CMP	BYTE [SI],":"	; Check for potential drive specifier
 29353 00004DCE 7519                    	JNZ	short NODRV
 29354 00004DD0 46                      	INC	SI		; Skip over colon
 29355 00004DD1 2C40                    	SUB	AL,"@"          ; Convert drive letter to drive number (A=1)
 29356 00004DD3 760F                    	JBE	short BADDRV	; Drive letter out of range
 29357                                  
 29358 00004DD5 50                      	PUSH	AX
 29359 00004DD6 E8D71A                  	call	GetVisDrv
 29360 00004DD9 58                      	POP	AX
 29361 00004DDA 730A                    	JNC	short HAVDRV
 29362                                  
 29363                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 29364                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 29365                                  ;hkn; SS override
 29366 00004DDC 36803E[1006]1A          	CMP	byte [SS:DrvErr],error_not_DOS_disk ; 1Ah
 29367                                  					; if not FAT drive ;AN000;
 29368 00004DE2 7402                    	JZ	short HAVDRV		; assume ok	   ;AN000;
 29369                                  BADDRV:
 29370 00004DE4 B2FF                    	MOV	DL,-1
 29371                                  HAVDRV:
 29372 00004DE6 AA                      	STOSB			; Put drive specifier in first byte
 29373 00004DE7 46                      	INC	SI
 29374 00004DE8 4F                      	DEC	DI		; Counteract next two instructions
 29375                                  NODRV:
 29376 00004DE9 4E                      	DEC	SI		; Back up
 29377 00004DEA 47                      	INC	DI		; Skip drive byte
 29378                                  
 29379                                  	;entry	NORMSCAN
 29380                                  NORMSCAN:
 29381 00004DEB B90800                  	MOV	CX,8
 29382 00004DEE E82200                  	CALL	GETWORD 	; Get 8-letter file name
 29383 00004DF1 803C2E                  	CMP	BYTE [SI],"."
 29384 00004DF4 7510                    	JNZ	short NODOT
 29385 00004DF6 46                      	INC	SI		; Skip over dot if present
 29386                                  
 29387                                  	; 24/09/2023
 29388                                  	;mov	cx,3
 29389 00004DF7 B103                    	mov	cl,3	; ch=0
 29390                                  
 29391                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 29392                                  ;hkn; SS override

 29394                                  	; 10/06/2019
 29395 00004DF9 36F606[1206]01          	test	byte [SS:DOS34_FLAG+1],(DBCS_VOLID2>>8) ; 1
 29396 00004DFF 7402                    	JZ	short VOLOK				;AN000;
 29397 00004E01 A4                      	MOVSB			; 2nd byte of DBCS	;AN000;
 29398                                  	; 24/09/2023
 29399                                  	;MOV	CX,2					;AN000;
 29400 00004E02 49                      	dec	cx  ; cx=2
 29401                                  	;JMP	SHORT contvol				;AN000;
 29402                                  VOLOK:

 29404                                  contvol:
 29405 00004E03 E81300                  	CALL	MUSTGETWORD
 29406                                  NODOT:
 29407 00004E06 88D0                    	MOV	AL,DL
 29408                                  
 29409                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 29410                                  	;and	word [ss:DOS34_FLAG],0FEFFh
 29411                                  	; 18/12/2022

 29413                                  	;and	word [ss:DOS34_FLAG],~DBCS_VOLID2 ; ### BUG FIX ###
 29414                                  
 29415 00004E0E C3                      	retn
 29416                                  
 29417                                  NONAM:

 29419 00004E11 4E                      	DEC	SI

 29423 00004E13 E89F00                  	CALL	GETLET		
 29424 00004E16 76F7                    	JBE	short NONAM	; Exit if invalid character
 29425 00004E18 4E                      	DEC	SI

 29438 00004E1C 750C                    	JNZ	short MustCheckCX

 29463 00004E44 C3                      	retn

 29470                                  scanb_retn:

 29473                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29474                                  ;
 29475                                  ; Procedure Name : NameTrans
 29476                                  ;
 29477                                  ; NameTrans is used by FindPath to scan off an element of a path. We must
 29478                                  ; allow spaces in pathnames
 29479                                  ;
 29480                                  ;   Inputs:	DS:SI points to start of path element
 29481                                  ;   Outputs:	Name1 has unpacked name, uppercased
 29482                                  ;		ES = DOSGroup
 29483                                  ;		DS:SI advanced after name
 29484                                  ;   Registers modified: DI,AX,DX,CX
 29485                                  ;
 29486                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29487                                  
 29488                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 29489                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 29490                                  
 29491                                  	; 29/02/2024 - Retro DOS v4.1
 29492                                  
 29493                                  NameTrans:
 29494                                  ;hkn; SS override
 29495 00004E4D 36C606[4E03]01          	MOV	BYTE [SS:SpaceFlag],1
 29496 00004E53 16                      	push	ss
 29497 00004E54 07                      	pop	es
 29498                                  
 29499                                  ;hkn; NAME1 is in DOSDATA
 29500 00004E55 BF[4B05]                	MOV	DI,NAME1
 29501 00004E58 57                      	PUSH	DI
 29502                                  
 29503                                  ; 29/02/2024
 29504                                  %if 0
 29505                                  	MOV	AX,'  '	; 2020h
 29506                                  	MOV	CX,5
 29507                                  	STOSB
 29508                                  	REP	STOSW		; Fill "FCB" at NAME1 with spaces
 29509                                  	XOR	AL,AL		; Set stuff for NORMSCAN
 29510                                  	MOV	DL,AL
 29511                                  %else
 29512                                  	; 29/02/2024
 29513                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 29514 00004E59 B020                    	mov     al,20h ; ' '
 29515 00004E5B B90B00                  	mov     cx,11
 29516 00004E5E F3AA                    	rep stosb               ; Fill "FCB" at NAME1 with spaces
 29517 00004E60 91                      	xchg    ax,cx
 29518 00004E61 99                      	cwd
 29519                                  %endif
 29520                                  
 29521 00004E62 AA                      	STOSB
 29522 00004E63 5F                      	POP	DI
 29523                                  
 29524 00004E64 E884FF                  	CALL	NORMSCAN
 29525                                  
 29526                                  ;hkn; SS override for NAME1
 29527 00004E67 36803E[4B05]E5          	CMP	byte [SS:NAME1],0E5H
 29528 00004E6D 75DD                    	jnz	short scanb_retn
 29529 00004E6F 36C606[4B05]05          	MOV	byte [SS:NAME1],5 ; Magic name translation
 29530 00004E75 C3                      	retn

 29540                                  ;hkn; Table	SEGMENT
 29541                                  ;	PUBLIC	CharType
 29542                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29543                                  
 29544                                  ; Character type table for file name scanning
 29545                                  ; Table provides a mapping of characters to validity bits.
 29546                                  ; Four bits are provided for each character. Values 7Dh and above
 29547                                  ; have all bits set, so that part of the table is chopped off, and
 29548                                  ; the translation routine is responsible for screening these values.
 29549                                  ; The bit values are defined in DOSSYM.INC
 29550                                  
 29551                                  ;	      ; ^A and NUL
 29552                                  ;CharType:
 29553                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29554                                  ;	      ; ^C and ^B
 29555                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29556                                  ;	      ; ^E and ^D
 29557                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29558                                  ;	      ; ^G and ^F
 29559                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29560                                  ;	      ; TAB and BS
 29561                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM+FSPCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29562                                  ;	      ; ^K and ^J
 29563                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29564                                  ;	      ; ^M and ^L
 29565                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29566                                  ;	      ; ^O and ^N
 29567                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29568                                  ;	      ; ^Q and ^P
 29569                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29570                                  ;	      ; ^S and ^R
 29571                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29572                                  ;	      ; ^U and ^T
 29573                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29574                                  ;	      ; ^W and ^V
 29575                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29576                                  ;	      ; ^Y and ^X
 29577                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29578                                  ;	      ; ESC and ^Z
 29579                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29580                                  ;	      ; ^] and ^;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29582                                  ;	      ; ^_ and ^^
 29583                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29584                                  ;	      ; ! and SPACE
 29585                                  ;	 db   LOW (NOT FCHK+FDELIM+FSPCHK)
 29586                                  ;	      ; # and "
 29587                                  ;	 db   LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK)
 29588                                  ;	      ; $ - )
 29589                                  ;	 db   3 dup (0FFh)
 29590                                  ;	      ; + and *
 29591                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) SHL 4) OR 0Fh
 29592                                  ;	      ; - and '
 29593                                  ;	 db   NOT (FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM)
 29594                                  ;	      ; / and .
 29595                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29596                                  ;	      ; 0 - 9
 29597                                  ;	 db   5 dup (0FFh)
 29598                                  ;	      ; ; and :
 29599                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) AND 0Fh
 29600                                  ;	      ; = and <
 29601                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) AND 0Fh
 29602                                  ;	      ; ? and >
 29603                                  ;	 db   NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM
 29604                                  ;	      ; A - Z
 29605                                  ;	 db   13 dup (0FFh)
 29606                                  ;	      ; \ and [
 29607                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR 0Fh
 29608                                  ;	      ; ^ and ]
 29609                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29610                                  ;	      ; _ - {
 29611                                  ;	 db   15 dup (0FFh)
 29612                                  ;	      ; } and |
 29613                                  ;	 db   NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM

 29895                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29896                                  ;
 29897                                  ;  GetCharType - return flag bits indicating character type
 29898                                  ;	Bits are defined in DOSSYM.INC. Uses lookup table
 29899                                  ;	defined above at label CharType.
 29900                                  ;
 29901                                  ;	Entry : AL = character to return type flags for
 29902                                  ;	Exit  : AL = type flags
 29903                                  ;	Uses  : AL, flags
 29904                                  ;
 29905                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29906                                  
 29907                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 29908                                  
 29909                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 29910                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 29911                                  GetCharType:
 29912                                  	;cmp	al,7Eh
 29913 00004EEE 3C7E                    	cmp	al,CharType_last 	; beyond end of table?
 29914 00004EF0 7316                    	jae	short gct_90		; return standard value
 29915                                  
 29916 00004EF2 53                      	push	bx
 29917 00004EF3 BB[764E]                	mov	bx,CharType		; load lookup table
 29918 00004EF6 D0E8                    	shr	al,1			; adjust for half-byte table entry size
 29919                                  	;xlat	cs:[bx] 		; get flags
 29920 00004EF8 2ED7                    	cs	xlat	
 29921 00004EFA 5B                      	pop	bx
 29922                                  
 29923                                  ; carry clear from previous shift means we want the low nibble.  Otherwise
 29924                                  ; we have to shift the flags down to the low nibble
 29925                                  
 29926 00004EFB 7308                    	jnc	short gct_80		; carry clear, no shift needed
 29927                                  
 29928 00004EFD D0E8                    	shr	al,1			; we want high nibble, shift it down
 29929 00004EFF D0E8                    	shr	al,1
 29930 00004F01 D0E8                    	shr	al,1
 29931 00004F03 D0E8                    	shr	al,1
 29932                                  gct_80:
 29933 00004F05 240F                    	and	al,0Fh			; clear the unused nibble
 29934 00004F07 C3                      	retn
 29935                                  gct_90:
 29936 00004F08 B00F                    	mov	al,0Fh			; set all flags
 29937 00004F0A C3                      	retn

 30375                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30376                                  ;
 30377                                  ; Procedure Name : CNTHAND ( CTRLC_C HANDLER )
 30378                                  ;
 30379                                  ; "^C" and CR/LF is printed. Then the user registers are restored and the
 30380                                  ; user CTRL-C handler is executed. At this point the top of the stack has 1)
 30381                                  ; the interrupt return address should the user CTRL-C handler wish to allow
 30382                                  ; processing to continue; 2) the original interrupt return address to the code
 30383                                  ; that performed the function call in the first place. If the user CTRL-C
 30384                                  ; handler wishes to continue, it must leave all registers unchanged and RET
 30385                                  ; (not IRET) with carry CLEAR. If carry is SET then an terminate system call
 30386                                  ; is simulated.
 30387                                  ;
 30388                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------

 31025                                  ;** --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31026                                  ;
 31027                                  ; reset_environment checks the DS value against the CurrentPDB. If they are
 31028                                  ; different, then an old-style return is performed. If they are the same,
 31029                                  ; then we release jfns and restore to parent. We still use the PDB at DS:0 as
 31030                                  ; the source of the terminate addresses.
 31031                                  ;
 31032                                  ; Some subtlety: We are about to issue a bunch of calls that *may* generate
 31033                                  ; INT 24s. We *cannot* allow the user to restart the abort process; we may
 31034                                  ; end up aborting the wrong process or turn a terminate/stay/resident into a
 31035                                  ; normal abort and leave interrupt handlers around. What we do is to set a
 31036                                  ; flag that will indicate that if any abort code is seen, we just continue the
 31037                                  ; operation. In essence, we dis-allow the abort response.

 31284                                  ;
 31285                                  ; Procedure Name : IsEOF
 31286                                  ;
 31287                                  ; IsEOF - check the fat value in BX for eof.
 31288                                  ;
 31289                                  ;   Inputs:	ES:BP point to DPB
 31290                                  ;		BX has fat value
 31291                                  ;   Outputs:	JAE eof

 31297                                  	;cmp	word [es:bp+0Dh],0FF6h

 31299 00005394 730B                    	JAE	short EOF16			; yes, check for eof there
 31300                                  
 31301                                  ;J.K. 8/27/86
 31302                                  ;Modified to accept 0FF0h as an eof. This is to handle the diskfull case
 31303                                  ;of any media that has "F0"(Other) as a MediaByte.
 31304                                  ;Hopely, this does not create any side effect for those who may use any value
 31305                                  ;other than "FF8-FFF" as an EOF for their own file.
 31306                                  
 31307 00005396 81FBF00F                	cmp	bx,0FF0h
 31308 0000539A 7404                    	je	short IsEOF_other
 31309                                  
 31310 0000539C 81FBF80F                	CMP	BX,0FF8h		; do the 12 bit compare
 31311                                  IsEOF_other:
 31312 000053A0 C3                      	retn
 31313                                  EOF16:
 31314 000053A1 83FBF8                  	CMP	BX,0FFF8h		; 16 bit compare
 31315 000053A4 C3                      	retn

 31318                                  
 31319                                  ;Break	<UNPACK -- UNPACK FAT ENTRIES>
 31320                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31321                                  ;
 31322                                  ; Procedur Name : UNPACK
 31323                                  ;
 31324                                  ; Inputs:
 31325                                  ;	BX = Cluster number (may be full 16-bit quantity)
 31326                                  ;	ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 31327                                  ; Outputs:
 31328                                  ;	DI = Contents of FAT for given cluster (may be full 16-bit quantity)
 31329                                  ;	Zero set means DI=0 (free cluster)
 31330                                  ;	Carry set means error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 31331                                  ; SI Destroyed, No other registers affected. Fatal error if cluster too big.
 31332                                  ;
 31333                                  ; NOTE: if BX = 0 then DI = contents of CL0FATENTRY
 31334                                  ;
 31335                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31336                                  	
 31337                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 31338                                  	; DOSCODE:94B5h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 31339                                  
 31340                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 31341                                  UNPACK:
 31342                                  	; MSDOS 6.0			; M014 - Start
 31343 000053A5 09DB                    	or	bx,bx			; Q: are we unpacking cluster 0
 31344 000053A7 7507                    	jnz	short up_cont		; N: proceed with normal unpack
 31345 000053A9 8B3E[8100]              	mov	di,[CL0FATENTRY]	; Y: return value in CL0FATENTRY
 31346 000053AD 09FF                    	or	di,di 			; return z if di=0
 31347 000053AF C3                      	retn				; done
 31348                                  up_cont:				; M014 - End
 31349                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 & MSDOS 6.0
 31350                                  	;cmp	bx,[es:bp+0Dh]
 31351 000053B0 263B5E0D                	CMP	BX,[ES:BP+DPB.MAX_CLUSTER]
 31352 000053B4 7726                    	JA	short HURTFAT

 31355 000053BB 8B3D                    	MOV	DI,[DI]

 31357 000053BF 268B760D                	MOV	SI,[ES:BP+DPB.MAX_CLUSTER] ; MZ is this 16-bit fat?
 31358 000053C3 81FEF60F                	CMP	SI,4096-10
 31359 000053C7 720C                    	JB	short Unpack12		; MZ No, go 'AND' off bits
 31360 000053C9 09FF                    	OR	DI,DI			; MZ set zero condition code, clears carry
 31361 000053CB EB0C                    	JMP	SHORT _DoContext 	; MZ go do context
 31362                                  High12:
 31363 000053CD D1EF                    	SHR	DI,1
 31364 000053CF D1EF                    	SHR	DI,1
 31365 000053D1 D1EF                    	SHR	DI,1
 31366 000053D3 D1EF                    	SHR	DI,1
 31367                                  Unpack12:

 31369                                  _DoContext:
 31370 000053D9 16                      	PUSH	SS
 31371 000053DA 1F                      	POP	DS
 31372 000053DB C3                      	retn
 31373                                  HURTFAT:

 31376 000053DC 26C7461FFFFF            	MOV	word [ES:BP+DPB.FREE_CNT],-1 ; Err in FAT must force recomp of freespace
 31377 000053E2 50                      	PUSH	AX
 31378 000053E3 B488                    	MOV	AH,Allowed_FAIL+80h ; 88h
 31379

 31384                                  ;

 31390 000053F6 F9                      	STC				; User said FAIL

 31392 000053F7 58                      	POP	AX
 31393                                  hurtfat_retn:
 31394 000053F8 C3                      	retn

 31398                                  ;Break	<PACK -- PACK FAT ENTRIES>
 31399                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31400                                  ;
 31401                                  ; Procedure Name : PACK
 31402                                  ;
 31403                                  ; Inputs:
 31404                                  ;	BX = Cluster number
 31405                                  ;	DX = Data
 31406                                  ;	ES:BP = Pointer to drive DPB
 31407                                  ; Outputs:
 31408                                  ;	The data is stored in the FAT at the given cluster.
 31409                                  ;	SI,DX,DI all destroyed
 31410                                  ;	Carry set means error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 31411                                  ;	No other registers affected
 31412                                  ;
 31413                                  ; NOTE: if BX = 0 then data in DX is stored in CL0FATENTRY.
 31414                                  ;
 31415                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31416                                  
 31417                                  	; 02/01/2024
 31418                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 31419                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 31420                                  PACK:
 31421                                  	; MSDOS 6.0			; M014 - start
 31422 000053F9 09DB                    	or	bx,bx			; Q: are we packing cluster 0

 31424 000053FD 8916[8100]              	mov	[CL0FATENTRY],dx	; Y: place value in CL0FATENTRY
 31425 00005401 C3                      	retn				; done
 31426                                  p_cont:					; M014 - end
 31427                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 & MSDOS 6.0
 31428 00005402 E88900                  	CALL	MAPCLUSTER
 31429 00005405 72D2                    	JC	short _DoContext
 31430 00005407 8B35                    	MOV	SI,[DI]
 31431 00005409 740B                    	JZ	short ALIGNED 		; byte (not nibble) aligned
 31432 0000540B 51                      	PUSH	CX			; move data to upper 12 bits
 31433 0000540C B104                    	MOV	CL,4
 31434 0000540E D3E2                    	SHL	DX,CL
 31435 00005410 59                      	POP	CX
 31436 00005411 83E60F                  	AND	SI,0FH			; leave in original low 4 bits
 31437 00005414 EB13                    	JMP	SHORT PACKIN
 31438                                  ALIGNED:
 31439                                  	;cmp	word [es:bp+0Dh],0FF6h
 31440 00005416 26817E0DF60F            	CMP	word [ES:BP+DPB.MAX_CLUSTER],4096-10 ; MZ 16 bit fats?
 31441 0000541C 7309                    	JAE	short Pack16		; MZ yes, go clobber original data
 31442 0000541E 81E600F0                	AND	SI,0F000h		; MZ leave in upper 4 bits of original
 31443                                  	;AND	DX,0FFFh		; MZ store only 12 bits
 31444                                  	; 01/07/2024
 31445 00005422 80E60F                  	and	dh,0Fh
 31446 00005425 EB02                    	JMP	SHORT PACKIN		; MZ go store
 31447                                  Pack16:
 31448 00005427 31F6                    	XOR	SI,SI			; MZ no original data
 31449                                  PACKIN:

 31451 0000542B 8935                    	MOV	[DI],SI
 31452                                  
 31453                                  ;hkn; SS override
 31454 0000542D 36C536[E205]            	LDS	SI,[SS:CURBUF]
 31455                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 31456 00005432 F6440540                	TEST	byte [SI+BUFFINFO.buf_flags],buf_dirty  
 31457                                  					;LB. if already dirty		  ;AN000;

 31461                                  	
 31462                                  	;or	byte [si+5],40h
 31463 0000543B 804C0540                	OR	byte [SI+BUFFINFO.buf_flags],buf_dirty  
 31464                                  yesdirty11:				;LB.				;AN000;
 31465                                  ;hkn; SS override
 31466 0000543F 36803E[7805]00          	CMP	BYTE [SS:CLUSSPLIT],0	; 15/08/2018

 31468 00005445 16                      	push	ss

 31470 00005447 74AF                    	jz	short hurtfat_retn	; Carry clear

 31473 0000544B 51                      	PUSH	CX

 31481                                  	;Context DS
