 40407                                  ;**	BinToAscii - convert a number to a string.
 40408                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 40409                                  ;	BinToAscii converts a 16 bit number into a 4 ascii characters.
 40410                                  ;	This routine is used to generate temp file names so we don't spend
 40411                                  ;	the time and code needed for a true hex number, we just use
 40412                                  ;	A thorugh O.
 40413                                  ;
 40414                                  ;	ENTRY	(ax) = value
 40415                                  ;		(es:di) = destination
 40416                                  ;	EXIT	(es:di) updated by 4
 40417                                  ;	USES	cx, di, flags
 40418                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 40419                                  
 40420                                  ; MSDOS 3.3
 40421                                  ;BinToAscii:
 40422                                  ;	mov     cx,4
 40423                                  ;bta5:
 40424                                  ;	push    cx
 40425                                  ;	mov     cl,4
 40426                                  ;	rol     ax,cl
 40427                                  ;	push    ax
 40428                                  ;	and     al,0Fh
 40429                                  ;	add     al,'0'
 40430                                  ;	cmp     al,'9'
 40431                                  ;	jbe     short bta6
 40432                                  ;	add     al,7
 40433                                  ;bta6: 
 40434                                  ;	stosb
 40435                                  ;	pop     ax
 40436                                  ;	pop     cx
 40437                                  ;	loop    bta5
 40438                                  ;	retn
 40439                                  
 40440                                  ; 15/03/2024
 40441                                  ; MSDOS 5.0-6.22 & Windows ME
 40442                                  ; (MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0B0D9h)
 40443                                  ; (Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:0ABA4h)
 40444                                  %if 1
 40445                                  
 40446                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 40447                                  BinToAscii:
 40448 00006ED0 B90404                  	mov	cx,404h			; (ch) = digit counter, (cl) = shift cnt
 40449                                  bta5:	
 40450 00006ED3 D3C0                    	ROL	AX,CL			; move leftmost nibble into rightmost
 40451 00006ED5 50                      	push	ax			; preserve remainder of digits
 40452 00006ED6 240F                    	AND	AL,0Fh			; grab low nibble
 40453 00006ED8 0441                    	ADD	AL,'A'			; turn into ascii
 40454 00006EDA AA                      	STOSB				; drop in the character
 40455 00006EDB 58                      	pop	ax			; (ax) = shifted number
 40456 00006EDC FECD                    	dec	ch
 40457 00006EDE 75F3                    	jnz	short bta5		; process 4 digits
 40458 00006EE0 C3                      	retn
 40459                                  %else

 40461                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:0C385h
 40462                                  
 40463                                  BinToAscii:

 40465                                  	xchg	ah,al

 40480                                  ;   $CreateTemp - given a directory, create a unique name in that directory.
 40481                                  ;	Method used is to get the current time, convert to a name and attempt
 40482                                  ;	a create new. Repeat until create new succeeds.
 40483                                  ;
 40484                                  ;   Inputs:	DS:DX point to a null terminated directory name.
 40485                                  ;		CX  contains default attributes

 40491                                  	; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)

 40494                                  	;Enter

 40505 00006EE7 F7C1D8FF                	test	CX,~attr_changeable
 40506 00006EEB 7405                    	JZ	short OKatts		; Ok if no non-changeable bits set
 40507                                  
 40508                                  ; We need this "hook" here to detect these cases (like user sets one both of
 40509                                  ; vol_id and dir bits) because of the structure of the or $CreateNewFile loop
 40510                                  ; below. The code loops on error_access_denied, but if one of the non
 40511                                  ; changeable attributes is specified, the loop COULD be infinite or WILL be
 40512                                  ; infinite because CreateNewFile will fail with access_denied always. Thus we
 40513                                  ; need to detect these cases before getting to the loop.

 41369                                  ;Break <ShareEnter - attempt to enter a node into the sharing set>
 41370                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41371                                  ;   ShareEnter - perform a retried entry of a nodde into the sharing set. If
 41372                                  ;   the max number of retries is exceeded, we notify the user via int 24.
 41373                                  ;
 41374                                  ;   Inputs:     ThisSFT points to the SFT
 41375                                  ;               WFP_Start points to the WFP
 41376                                  ;   Outputs:    Carry clear => successful entry

 41378                                  ;   Registers modified: all

 41392 0000717E 59                      	pop	cx
 41393 0000717F 730A                    	jnc	short done		; success, let the user see this
 41394 00007181 E860A0                  	call	Idle                    ; wait a while
 41395 00007184 E2EA                    	loop    attempt                 ; go back for another attempt
 41396 00007186 E8BEFF                  	call    SHARE_VIOLATION         ; signal the problem to the user
 41397 00007189 73E1                    	jnc	short retry		; user said to retry, go do it
 41398                                  done:
 41399 0000718B 59                      	pop	cx
 41400 0000718C C3                      	retn

 41573                                  ;
 41574                                  ; procedure : Rational386Patch
 41575                                  ;
 41576                                  ; Older versions of the Rational DOS Extender have several bugs which trash
 41577                                  ; 386 registers (usually just the high word of 32 bit registers) during
 41578                                  ; interrupt processing. Lotus 123 3.1+ is a popular application that uses a
 41579                                  ; version of the Rational extender with the 32 bit register trashing bugs.
 41580                                  ;
 41581                                  ; This routine applies patches to the Rational DOS Extender to work around
 41582                                  ; most of the register trashing bugs.
 41583                                  ;
 41584                                  ; Note that there are additional register trashing bugs not fixed by these
 41585                                  ; patches. In particular, the high word of ESP and the FS and GS registers
 41586                                  ; may be modified on interrupts.
 41587                                  ;
 41588                                  ; There are two different Rational DOS Extender patchs in this module.
 41589                                  ; Rational386Patch is to correct 386 register trashing bugs on 386 or later
 41590                                  ; processors. This patch code is executed when MS-DOS is running on a 386
 41591                                  ; or later processor, regardless of whether MS-DOS is running in the HMA
 41592                                  ; or not.
 41593                                  ;
 41594                                  ; The other Rational patch routine (RationalPatch, below) fixes a register
 41595                                  ; trashing problem on 286 processors, and is only executed if MS-DOS is
 41596                                  ; running in the HMA.
 41597                                  ;
 41598                                  ; This patch detection and replacement is based on an example supplied by
 41599                                  ; Ben Williams at Rational.
 41600                                  ;
 41601                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41602                                  
 41603                                  ; 22/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 41604                                  ; DOSCODE:B448h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)

 41886                                  Rational386Patch:
 41887                                  	; Do a few quick checks to see if this looks like a Rational
 41888                                  	; Extended application. Hopefully this will quickly weed out
 41889                                  	; most non Rational apps.
 41890                                  
 41891                                  	cmp	word [es:0],395		; version number goes here - versions
 41892                                  	jae	short rp3QuickOut	;   3.95+ don't need patching
 41893                                  
 41894                                  	cmp	word [es:0Ch],20h	; always has this value here
 41895                                  	jne	short rp3QuickOut
 41896                                  
 41897                                  	push	ax
 41898                                  
 41899                                  	mov	ax,18h 			; extender has 18h at
 41900                                  	cmp	[es:24],ax		;   offsets 24, 28, & 36
 41901                                  	jne	short rp3QO_ax
 41902                                  	cmp	[es:28],ax
 41903                                  	jne	short rp3QO_ax
 41904                                  	cmp	[es:36],ax
 41905                                  	je	short rp3Maybe
 41906                                  rp3QO_ax:
 41907                                  	pop	ax
 41908                                  rp3QuickOut:
 41909                                  	retn
 41910                                  
 41911                                  ; It might be the rational extender, do more extensive checking
 41912                                  
 41913                                  rp3Maybe:
 41914                                  	cld
 41915                                  	push	bx			; note ax pushed above
 41916                                  	push	cx
 41917                                  	push	dx
 41918                                  	push	si
 41919                                  	push	di
 41920                                  	push	es
 41921                                  	push	ds			; we use all of them
 41922                                  	push	bp
 41923                                  	sub	sp,StackVars.size  ; 6	; make space for stack variables
 41924                                  	mov	bp,sp
 41925                                  
 41926                                  	push	cs
 41927                                  	pop	ds
 41928                                  
 41929                                  	mov	ax,[es:0]		; save version #
 41930                                  	;mov	[bp+StackVars.sv_wVersion],ax
 41931                                  	mov	[bp],ax	
 41932                                  					; check that binary version # matches
 41933                                  	call	VerifyVersion		;   ascii string
 41934                                  	jne	short rp3Exit_j

 41936                                  ; Looks like this is it, find where to put the patch code.  The
 41937                                  ; patch will be located on top of Rational code specific to 80286
 41938                                  ; processors, so these patchs MUST NOT be applied if running on
 41939                                  ; an 80286 system.

 41942

 41944                                  	;mov	[bp+2],cx

 42021                                  						;   area pointer

 42054                                  						;   main-line code

 42057                                  ; after the code in the patch area
 42058                                  
 42059                                  	pop	di				; repl5 location

 42061                                  
 42062                                  	;mov	ax,[bp+4]

 42064

 42070                                  	;mov	[es:si+0Dh],ax

 42074

 42077                                  						; patch area

 42153                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42154                                  ;
 42155                                  ; FindBadCode
 42156                                  ;
 42157                                  ; Searches Rational code segment looking for a pair of find strings (all
 42158                                  ; patches have at least two find strings).
 42159                                  ;
 42160                                  ; Entry:
 42161                                  ;	ES    = code segment to search
 42162                                  ;	DS:BX = search pair structure for this search
 42163                                  ;	[bp].sv_cbCodeSeg = length of code seg to search
 42164                                  ;
 42165                                  ; Exit:
 42166                                  ;	CY flag clear if both strings found, and
 42167                                  ;	SI    = offset in ES of 1st string
 42168                                  ;	DI    = offset in ES of 2nd string
 42169                                  ;	CY set if either string not found, or strings too far apart
 42170                                  ;
 42171                                  ; Used:
 42172                                  ;	CX
 42173                                  ;
 42174                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42175                                  
 42176                                  ;struc SearchPair
 42177                                  ; .sp_off1: resw 1	; offset of 1st search string
 42178                                  ; .sp_len1: resw 1	; length of 1st search string
 42179                                  ; .sp_off2: resw 1	; 2nd string
 42180                                  ; .sp_len2: resw 1	; 2nd string
 42181                                  ; .sp_diff: resw 1	; max difference between offsets
 42182                                  ; .size:
 42183                                  ;endstruc
 42184                                  
 42185                                  FindBadCode:
 42186                                  	;mov	cx,[bp+2]
 42187                                  	mov	cx,[bp+StackVars.sv_cbCodeSeg]	; search length
 42188                                  
 42189                                  	mov	si,[bx]	; mov si,[bx+0]
 42190                                  	;mov	si,[bx+Searchpair.sp_off1] ; ds:si -> search string
 42191                                  
 42192                                  	;mov	dx,[bx+2]
 42193                                  	mov	dx,[bx+SearchPair.sp_len1] ; dx = search len
 42194                                  	call	ScanCodeSeq
 42195                                  	jnz	short fbc_error		; done if 1st not found
 42196                                  
 42197                                  	push	di			; save 1st string offset
 42198                                  
 42199                                  	;mov	si,[bx+4]
 42200                                  	mov	si,[bx+SearchPair.sp_off2]
 42201                                  	;mov	dx,[bx+6]
 42202                                  	mov	dx,[bx+SearchPair.sp_len2]
 42203                                  	call	ScanCodeSeq_di		; don't change flags after this!
 42204                                  
 42205                                  	pop	si			; restore 1st string offset
 42206                                  	jnz	short fbc_error
 42207                                  
 42208                                  	mov	ax,di			; sanity check that
 42209                                  	sub	ax,si			;   si < di && di - si <= allowed diff
 42210                                  	;jc	short fbc_error
 42211                                  	; 04/02/2026
 42212                                  	jc	short fbc_err
 42213                                  	;cmp	ax,[bx+8]
 42214                                  	cmp	ax,[bx+SearchPair.sp_diff]
 42215                                  	ja	short fbc_error
 42216                                  
 42217                                  	clc
 42218                                  	retn
 42219                                  
 42220                                  fbc_error:
 42221                                  	stc
 42222                                  fbc_err:
 42223                                  	retn
 42224                                  
 42225                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42226                                  ;
 42227                                  ; GenPatch
 42228                                  ;
 42229                                  ; Generate a patch sequence. 1) insert a jump at the buggy code location
 42230                                  ; (jumps to the patch code area), 2) copy the selected patch code to the
 42231                                  ; patch area, 3) insert a jump from the patch area back to the main-line
 42232                                  ; code.
 42233                                  ;
 42234                                  ; Entry:
 42235                                  ;	ES:DI = start of buggy code to be patched
 42236                                  ;	DX    = length of buggy code to be patched
 42237                                  ;	DS:SI = replacement patch code
 42238                                  ;	CX    = length of replacement patch code
 42239                                  ;	[bp].sv_pPatch = offset in ES of where to copy patch code
 42240                                  ;
 42241                                  ; Exit:
 42242                                  ;	DI, [bp].sv_pPatch = byte after generated patch code
 42243                                  ;
 42244                                  ; Used:
 42245                                  ;	AX, BX, SI, Flags
 42246                                  ;
 42247                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42248                                  
 42249                                  GenPatch:
 42250                                  	push	di			;save offset of buggy code
 42251                                  
 42252                                  	;mov	bx,[bp+4]
 42253                                  	mov	bx,[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch]
 42254                                  					;jump from buggy code to patch area
 42255                                  	call	GenJump
 42256                                  
 42257                                  	call	CopyPatch		;copy replacement code to patch area
 42258                                  
 42259                                  	pop	bx			;offset of buggy code + buggy code
 42260                                  	add	bx,dx			;  length = return from patch offset
 42261                                  
 42262                                  	call	GenJump 		;jump from patch area back to main-
 42263                                  	;mov	[bp+4],di
 42264                                  	mov	[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch],di
 42265                                  					;  line code, update patch pointer
 42266                                  	retn
 42267                                  
 42268                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42269                                  ;
 42270                                  ; CopyPatch
 42271                                  ;
 42272                                  ; Copies patch code to patch location.
 42273                                  ;
 42274                                  ; Entry:
 42275                                  ;	DS:SI = patch code to be copied
 42276                                  ;	ES    = segment of code to patch
 42277                                  ;	CX    = length of code to copy
 42278                                  ;	[bp].sv_pPatch = offset in ES of where to copy patch code
 42279                                  ;
 42280                                  ; Exit:
 42281                                  ;	DI, [bp].sv_pPatch = byte after copied patch code
 42282                                  ;
 42283                                  ; Used:
 42284                                  ;	SI, Flags
 42285                                  ;
 42286                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42287                                  
 42288                                  CopyPatch:
 42289                                  	push	cx
 42290                                  	;mov	di,[bp+4]
 42291                                  	mov	di,[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch] ;patch pointer is the dest offset
 42292                                  	cld
 42293                                  	rep movsb
 42294                                  	pop	cx
 42295                                  	;mov	[bp+4],di
 42296                                  	mov	[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch],di ;update net pointer location
 42297                                  	retn
 42298                                  
 42299                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42300                                  ;
 42301                                  ; GenJump
 42302                                  ;
 42303                                  ; Generates a rel16 JMP instruction at location 'from' to location 'to'.
 42304                                  ;
 42305                                  ; Entry:
 42306                                  ;	ES:DI = from location (where to put jmp instruction)
 42307                                  ;	BX    = to location (where to jump to)
 42308                                  ;
 42309                                  ; Exit:
 42310                                  ;	DI = byte after generated jump
 42311                                  ;
 42312                                  ; Used:
 42313                                  ;	AX
 42314                                  ;
 42315                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42316                                  
 42317                                  GenJump:
 42318                                  	mov	al,0E9h		; jmp rel16 opcode
 42319                                  	stosb
 42320                                  
 42321                                  	mov	ax,bx		; calc offset to 'to' location
 42322                                  	sub	ax,di
 42323                                  	sub	ax,2
 42324                                  
 42325                                  	stosw			; output offset
 42326                                  
 42327                                  	retn
 42328                                  
 42329                                  ; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42330                                  ; (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 42331                                  
 42332                                  ; DOSCODE:B6D8h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 42333                                  ; 21/03/2024 - Retro DOS v4.2
 42334                                  ; DOSCODE:B6BEh (MSDOS 6.22, MSDOS.SYS)
 42335                                  
 42336                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42337                                  ;
 42338                                  ; ScanCodeSeq
 42339                                  ;
 42340                                  ; Looks for a pattern pointed to by DS:SI & len DX in ES:200 to ES:200+CX-1
 42341                                  ;
 42342                                  ; returns in ES:DI the start of the pattern if Zero flag is set
 42343                                  ;
 42344                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42345                                  
 42346                                  ScanCodeSeq:
 42347                                  	mov	di,200h
 42348                                  ScanCodeSeq_di:
 42349                                  	push	cx
 42350                                  	sub	cx,dx
 42351                                  	inc	cx
 42352                                  scsagain:
 42353                                  	push	si
 42354                                  	push	di
 42355                                  	push	cx
 42356                                  	mov	cx,dx
 42357                                  	rep	cmpsb
 42358                                  	pop	cx
 42359                                  	pop	di
 42360                                  	pop	si
 42361                                  	je	short scsfound
 42362                                  	inc	di
 42363                                  	loop	scsagain
 42364                                  scsfound:
 42365                                  	pop	cx
 42366                                  vvexit:		; 18/12/2022
 42367                                  	retn
 42368                                  
 42369                                  ; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42370                                  ; (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 42371                                  
 42372                                  ; DOSCODE:B6F0h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 42373                                  ; 21/03/2024 - Retro DOS v4.2
 42374                                  ; DOSCODE:B6D6h (MSDOS 6.22, MSDOS.SYS)
 42375                                  	
 42376                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42377                                  ;
 42378                                  ; VerifyVersion
 42379                                  ;
 42380                                  ; Checks whether the binary version from ES:0 matches the ASCII version
 42381                                  ; from ES:2A.
 42382                                  ;
 42383                                  ;       Entry: AX = binary version number 
 42384                                  ;       Exit : Z flag set if version numbers match
 42385                                  ;
 42386                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42387                                  
 42388                                  VerifyVersion:
 42389                                  	mov	si,[es:2Ah]		; offset of version number
 42390                                  					;  in ascii
 42391                                  	mov	bl,10
 42392                                  	add	si,3			; point to last digit
 42393                                  
 42394                                  	call	VVDigit
 42395                                  	jne	short vvexit
 42396                                  	call	VVDigit
 42397                                  	jne	short vvexit
 42398                                  	cmp	byte [es:si],'.'
 42399                                  	jne	short vvexit
 42400                                  	dec	si
 42401                                  	;call	VVDigit
 42402                                  	; 18/12/2022
 42403                                  	;jmp	short VVDigit
 42404                                  ;vvexit:
 42405                                  	;retn
 42406                                  VVDigit:
 42407                                  	div	bl
 42408                                  	add	ah,'0'
 42409                                  	dec	si
 42410                                  	cmp	[es:si+1],ah
 42411                                  	mov	ah,0			; do not xor or sub we need Z
 42412                                  	retn
 42413                                  
 42414                                  %endif

 42683                                  ; Procedure Name 	: ExePackPatch
 42684                                  ;
 42685                                  ; Inputs	 	: DS 			-> DOSDATA
 42686                                  ;			  ES:0 			-> read in image
 42687                                  ;			  ax:cx = start cs:ip of program
 42688                                  ; Output		:		
 42689                                  ;
 42690                                  ;	1. If ES <= 0fffh
 42691                                  ;	   2. if exepack signature ('RB') found
 42692                                  ;	      3. if common code to patch compares (for 3 diff. versions)
 42693                                  ;	       	 4. if rest of the code & checksum compares
 42694                                  ;	  	    5. overlay buggy code with code in 
 42695                                  ;		       doscode:str1.
 42696                                  ;		 6. endif
 42697                                  ;	      7. endif
 42698                                  ;	   8. endif
 42699                                  ;	9. endif

 43036                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 43037                                  ;
 43038                                  ; procedure : RationalPatch
 43039                                  ;
 43040                                  ; A routine (in Ration DOS extender) which is invoked at hardware interrupts
 43041                                  ; clobbers CX register on 286 machines. (123 release 3 uses Rational DOS
 43042                                  ; extender). This routine identifies Buggy Rational EXEs and fixes the bug.
 43043                                  ;
 43044                                  ; THE BUG is in the following code sequence:
 43045                                  ;
 43046                                  ;8b 0e 10 00	mov	cx, ds:[10h]		; delay count
 43047                                  ;90		even				; word align
 43048                                  ;e2 fe		loop	$			; wait		CLOBBERS CX
 43049                                  ;e8 xx xx	call	set_A20			; enable A20
 43050                                  ;
 43051                                  ; This patch routine replaces the mov & the loop with a far call into a
 43052                                  ; routine in DOS data segment which is in low memory (because A20 line
 43053                                  ; is off). The routine (RatBugCode) in DOS data saves & restores CX around
 43054                                  ; a mov & loop.
 43055                                  ;
 43056                                  ; Identification of Buggy Rational EXE
 43057                                  ; ====================================
 43058                                  ;
 43059                                  ; (ALL OFFSETS ARE IN THE PROGRAM SECTION - EXCLUDING THE EXE HEADER)
 43060                                  ;
 43061                                  ; OFFSET				Contains
 43062                                  ; ------				--------
 43063                                  ; 0000h			100 times Version number in binary
 43064                                  ;			bug exists in version 3.48 thru 3.83 (both inclusive)
 43065                                  ;
 43066                                  ; 000ah			the WORDS : 0000h, 0020h, 0000h, 0040h, 0001h
 43067                                  ;
 43068                                  ; 002ah			offset where version number is stored in ASCII
 43069                                  ;				e.g. '3.48A'
 43070                                  ;
 43071                                  ; 0030h			offset of copyright string. Copyright strings either
 43072                                  ;			start with "DOS/16M Copyright...." or
 43073                                  ;			"Copyright.....". The string contains
 43074                                  ;			"Rational Systems, Inc."
 43075                                  ;
 43076                                  ; 0020h			word : Paragraph offset of the buggy code segment
 43077                                  ;				from the program image
 43078                                  ; 0016h			word : size of buggy code segment
 43079                                  ;
 43080                                  ;	Buggy code is definite to start after offset 200h in its segment
 43081                                  ;
 43082                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 43083                                  
 43084                                  ; 23/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 43085                                  ; DOSCODE:B976h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 43086                                  
 43087                                  ; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 43088                                  ; DOSCODE:B654h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 43089                                  
 43090                                  RScanPattern1:
 43091                                  	db	0, 0, 20h, 0, 0, 0, 40h, 0, 1, 0
 43092                                  
 43093                                  RLen1 equ $ - RScanPattern1
 43094                                  
 43095                                  RScanPattern2:
 43096                                  	db	8Bh, 0Eh, 10h, 00h, 90h, 0E2h, 0FEh, 0E8h
 43097                                  
 43098                                  RLen2 equ $ - RScanPattern2
 43099                                  
 43100                                  RScanPattern3:
 43101                                  	db	8Bh, 0Eh, 10h, 00h, 0E2h, 0FEh, 0E8h
 43102                                  
 43103                                  RLen3 equ $ - RScanPattern2
 43104                                  
 43105                                  ; DOSCODE:B98Fh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 43106                                  ; DOSCODE:B66Dh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 43107                                  
 43108                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 43109                                  ;
 43110                                  ; INPUT : ES = segment where program got loaded
 43111                                  ;
 43112                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 43113

 43115                                  	cld
 43116

 43123                                  	push	si
 43124                                  	push	di

 43127                                  	;;;
 43128                                  	pusha
 43129                                  	;;;
 43130                                  %endif
 43131                                  	push	es
 43132                                  	push	ds			; we use all of them
 43133                                  	mov	di,0Ah			; look for pat1 at offset 0Ah
 43134                                  	push	cs
 43135                                  	pop	ds
 43136                                  	
 43137                                  	mov	si,RScanPattern1
 43138                                  	;mov	cx,10
 43139                                  	mov	cx,RLen1
 43140                                  	rep	cmpsb			; do we have the pattern ?
 43141                                  	jne	short rpexit
 43142                                  	mov	ax,[es:0]
 43143                                  	cmp	ax,348			; is it a buggy version ?
 43144                                  	jb	short rpexit
 43145                                  	cmp	ax,383			; is it a buggy version ?
 43146                                  	ja	short rpexit
 43147

 43152                                  	sub	cx,200h			; Length we search (we start
 43153                                  					;  at offset 200h)

 43155                                  	mov	si,RScanPattern2
 43156                                  	;mov	dx,8

 43162                                  	;mov	dx,15

 43170                                  ;	dx has the length of the code seq we were searching for

 43173                                  	stosb

 43175                                  	stosw
 43176                                  	mov	ax,ss
 43177                                  	stosw
 43178                                  	mov	cx,dx
 43179                                  	sub	cx,6			; filler (with NOPs)
 43180                                  	mov	al,90h
 43181                                  	rep	stosb
 43182                                  rpexit:
 43183                                  	pop	ds
 43184                                  	pop	es
 43185                                  
 43186                                  ; 21/03/2024
 43187                                  %if 0
 43188                                  	pop	di

 43191                                  	pop	cx
 43192                                  	pop	bx
 43193                                  	pop	ax

 43195                                  	; 21/03/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 43196                                  	;;;
 43197                                  	popa
 43198                                  	;;;
 43199                                  %endif
 43200                                  	retn

 44286                                  ; Procedure Name : seg_reinit
 44287                                  ;
 44288                                  ; Inputs	 : ES has final dos code location
 44289                                  ;		   AX = 0 / 1
 44290                                  ;
 44291                                  ; Outputs	 : Patch in the sharer and other tables with seg in ES
 44292                                  ;		   if AX =0
 44293                                  ;		      if first entry

 44295                                  ;			 and stub with segment in ES

 44298                                  ;
 44299                                  ;		   else if AX = 1
 44300                                  ;			patch segment of vectors with segment in ES	
 44301                                  ;
 44302                                  ; NOTE		 : This routine can be called at most twice!
 44303                                  ;
 44304                                  ; Regs Mod.	 : es, ax, di, cx, bx

 44424                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44425                                  ;
 44426                                  ; Procedure Name : WhatCPUType
 44427                                  ;
 44428                                  ; Inputs	 : none
 44429                                  ;
 44430                                  ; Outputs	 : AL = 0 if CPU <  286
 44431                                  ;		      = 1 if CPU == 286
 44432                                  ;		      = 2 if CPU >= 386
 44433                                  ;
 44434                                  ; Regs. Mod.	 : AX
 44435                                  ;
 44436                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44437                                  
 44438                                  WhatCPUType:
 44439                                  	; 25/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 44440                                  	;get_cpu_type	; done with a MACRO which can't be generated > once
 44441                                  
 44442                                  	;CPUTYPE.INC (MSDOS 6.0, 1991)
 44443                                  
 44444                                  ; Note: this must be a macro, and not a subroutine in the BIOS since
 44445                                  ; 	it is called from both CODE and SYSINITSEG.
 44446                                  ;
 44447                                  ;------GET_CPU_TYPE-----------------------------------May, 88 by M.Williamson
 44448                                  ;  Returns: AX = 0 if 8086 or 8088
 44449                                  ;              = 1 if 80286
 44450                                  ;              = 2 if 80386
 44451                                  
 44452                                  	; 04/11/2022
 44453                                  	; MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0BB03h
 44454                                  
 44455                                  Get_CPU_Type:	;macro
 44456                                  	pushf
 44457                                  	push	bx			; preserve bx
 44458                                  	xor	bx,bx			; init bx to zero
 44459                                  
 44460                                  	xor	ax,ax			; 0000 into AX
 44461                                  	push	ax			; put it on the stack...
 44462                                  	popf				; ...then shove it into the flags
 44463                                  	pushf				; get it back out of the flags...
 44464                                  	pop	ax			; ...and into ax
 44465                                  	and	ax,0F000h		; mask off high four bits
 44466                                  	cmp	ax,0F000h		; was it all 1's?
 44467                                  	je	short cpu_8086		; aye; it's an 8086 or 8088
 44468                                  
 44469                                  	mov	ax,0F000h		; now try to set the high four bits..
 44470                                  	push	ax
 44471                                  	popf
 44472                                  	pushf
 44473                                  	pop	ax			; ...and see what happens
 44474                                  	and	ax,0F000h		; any high bits set ?
 44475                                  	jz	short cpu_286		; nay; it's an 80286
 44476                                  
 44477                                  cpu_386:				; bx starts as zero
 44478                                  	inc	bx			; inc twice if 386
 44479                                  cpu_286:				; just inc once if 286
 44480                                  	inc	bx
 44481                                  cpu_8086:				; don't inc at all if 086
 44482                                  	mov	ax,bx			; put CPU type value in ax
 44483                                  	pop	bx			; restore original bx
 44484                                  	popf
 44485                                  	
 44486                                  	;endm
 44487                                  
 44488                                  	; 04/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 44489                                  	retn	; 19/09/2023
 44490                                  
 44491                                  ; 19/09/2023
 44492                                  ;	; 04/11/2022
 44493                                  ;	; MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0BB27h
 44494                                  ;	cmp	al,1
 44495                                  ;	jne	short sr_done 		; we need Rational Patch only
 44496                                  ;					;  on 286 systems
 44497                                  ;	mov	word [RationalPatchPtr],RationalPatch
 44498                                  
 44499                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44500                                  %endif	; 28/12/2022
 44501

 44872                                  ;	Description:
 44873                                  ;		This routine patches in 2 nops at the offsets specified in 
 44874                                  ;	patch_table. This basically enables the low mem stub to start 
 44875                                  ;	making XMS calls.
 44876                                  ;
 44877                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44878                                  
 44879                                  	; 04/11/2022
 44880                                  	; (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 44881                                  	; DOSCODE:0BC50h
 44882                                  
 44883                                  patch_table:	; label	byte
 44884                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i0patch
 44885                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i20patch
 44886                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i21patch
 44887                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i25patch
 44888                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i26patch
 44889                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i27patch
 44890                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i2fpatch
 44891                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:cpmpatch
 44892 000078F5 [8A10]                  	dw	i0patch
 44893 000078F7 [9410]                  	dw	i20patch
 44894 000078F9 [9E10]                  	dw	i21patch
 44895 000078FB [A810]                  	dw	i25patch
 44896 000078FD [B210]                  	dw	i26patch
 44897 000078FF [BC10]                  	dw	i27patch
 44898 00007901 [C610]                  	dw	i2fpatch
 44899 00007903 [D010]                  	dw	cpmpatch
 44900                                  
 44901                                  patch_table_size equ ($-patch_table)/2
 44902                                  
 44903                                  patch_in_nops:
 44904 00007905 50                      	push	ax
 44905 00007906 56                      	push	si
 44906 00007907 BE[F578]                	mov	si,patch_table
 44907 0000790A B89090                  	mov	ax,9090h ; nop, nop

 44909                                  	; cx = 0
 44910                                  	;mov	cx,8

 44913                                  pin_loop:
 44914 0000790F 2E8B3C                  	mov	di,[cs:si]
 44915 00007912 AB                      	stosw
 44916                                  	;add	si,2
 44917                                  	; 17/12/2022
 44918 00007913 46                      	inc	si
 44919 00007914 46                      	inc	si
 44920 00007915 E2F8                    	loop	pin_loop
 44921 00007917 5E                      	pop	si
 44922 00007918 58                      	pop	ax
 44923 00007919 C3                      	retn

 45125                                  ;; INT 21,52 - Get Pointer to DOS "INVARS" (Undocumented)
 45126                                  ;;
 45127                                  ;;	AH = 52h
 45128                                  ;;
 45129                                  ;;	on return:
 45130                                  ;;	ES:BX = pointer to DOS "invars", a table of pointers used by DOS.
 45131                                  ;;		Known "invars" fields follow (varies with DOS version):
 45132                                  ;;
 45133                                  ;;	Offset Size		 Description
 45134                                  ;;
 45135                                  ;;	 -12   word   sharing retry count (DOS 3.1-3.3)
 45136                                  ;;	 -10   word   sharing retry delay  (DOS 3.1-3.3)
 45137                                  ;;	  -8   dword  pointer to current disk buffer (DOS 3.x)
 45138                                  ;;	  -4   word   pointer in DOS code segment of unread CON input;
 45139                                  ;;		      0 indicates no unread input (DOS 3.x)
 45140                                  ;;	  -2   word   segment of first Memory Control Block (MCB)
 45141                                  ;;	  00   dword  pointer to first DRIVE PARAMETER TABLE (A:) in chain
 45142                                  ;;	  04   dword  pointer to DOS System File Table (SFT)
 45143                                  ;;	  08   dword  pointer to $CLOCK device driver
 45144                                  ;;	  0C   dword  pointer to CON device driver
 45145                                  ;;	  10   byte   number of logical drives in system
 45146                                  ;;	  11   word   maximum bytes/block of any block device
 45147                                  ;;	  13   dword  pointer to DOS cache buffer header
 45148                                  ;;	  17 18bytes  NUL device header, first 4 bytes of device header
 45149                                  ;;		      point to the next device in device chain

 45364                                  
 45365                                  ;Break <Initialized data and data used at DOS initialization>
 45366                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 45367                                  
 45368                                  ; We need to identify the parts of the data area that are relevant to tasks
 45369                                  ; and those that are relevant to the system as a whole.  Under 3.0, the system
 45370                                  ; data will be gathered with the system code.  The process data under 2.x will
 45371                                  ; be available for swapping and under 3.0 it will be allocated per-process.
 45372                                  ;
 45373                                  ; The data that is system data will be identified by [SYSTEM] in the comments
 45374                                  ; describing that data item.
 45375                                  
 45376                                  ;DOSDATA SEGMENT WORD PUBLIC 'DATA'
 45377                                  
 45378                                  ;
 45379                                  ; Table of routines for assignable devices
 45380                                  ;
 45381                                  ; MSDOS allows assignment if the following standard devices:
 45382                                  ;   stdin  (usually CON input)
 45383                                  ;   stdout (usually CON output)
 45384                                  ;   auxin  (usually AUX input)
 45385                                  ;   auxout (usually AUX output)
 45386                                  ;   stdlpt (usually PRN output)
 45387                                  ;
 45388                                  ; SPECIAL NOTE:
 45389                                  ;   Status of a file is a strange idea. We choose to handle it in this manner:
 45390                                  ;   If we're not at end-of-file, then we always say that we have a character.
 45391                                  ;   Otherwise, we return ^Z as the character and set the ZERO flag. In this
 45392                                  ;   manner we can support program written under the old DOS (they use ^Z as EOF
 45393                                  ;   on devices) and programs written under the new DOS (they use the ZERO flag
 45394                                  ;   as EOF).
 45395                                  
 45396                                  ; Default SFTs for boot up
 45397                                  
 45398                                  		;PUBLIC	SFTABL
 45399                                  
 45400                                  SFTABL:	   ; LABEL   DWORD		; [SYSTEM] file table
 45401 000000CC FFFF                    		DW -1			; [SYSTEM] link to next table
 45402 000000CE FFFF                    		DW -1			; [SYSTEM] link seg to next table
 45403 000000D0 0500                    		DW sf_default_number	; [SYSTEM] Number of entries in table
 45404                                  		;times 295 db 0 ; MSDOS 6.0
 45405 000000D2 00<rep 127h>            		times (sf_default_number*sf_entry_size) db 0
 45406                                  
 45407                                  ; the next two variables relate to the position of the logical stdout/stdin
 45408                                  ; cursor. They are only meaningful when stdin/stdout are assigned to the
 45409                                  ; console.
 45410                                  		; DOSDATA:01F9h (MSDOS 6.21)
 45411 000001F9 00                      CARPOS:		db 0			; [SYSTEM] cursor position in stdin
 45412 000001FA 00                      STARTPOS:	db 0			; [SYSTEM] position of cursor at beginning
 45413                                  					;	   of buffered input call
 45414 000001FB 00<rep 80h>             INBUF:		times 128 db 0		; [SYSTEM] general device input buffer
 45415 0000027B 00<rep 83h>             CONBUF:		times 131 db 0		; [SYSTEM] The rest of INBUF and console buffer
 45416                                  		; DOSDATA:02FEh (MSDOS 6.21)
 45417 000002FE 00                      PFLAG:		db 0			; [SYSTEM] printer echoing flag
 45418 000002FF 00                      VERFLG:		db 0			; [SYSTEM] Initialize with verify off
 45419 00000300 03                      CHARCO:		db 00000011b		; [SYSTEM] Allows statchks every 4 chars...
 45420                                  switch_character:
 45421 00000301 2F                      chSwitch:	db '/'			; UNUSED - obsolete datum, can be reused
 45422 00000302 00                      AllocMethod:	db 0			; [SYSTEM] how to alloc first(best)last
 45423 00000303 00                      fShare:		db 0			; [SYSTEM] TRUE => sharing installed
 45424 00000304 01                      DIFFNAM:	db 1			; [SYSTEM] Indicates when MYNAME has changed
 45425 00000305 20<rep 10h>             MYNAME:		times 16 db 20h		; [SYSTEM] My network name

 45448                                  ;ELSE
 45449                                  ;	DW	0

 45451                                  ;ENDIF
 45452                                  ;ENDM

 45627                                  ; Retro DOS v4.0 NOTE: (by Erdogan Tan, 25/04/2019)
 45628                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------
 45629                                  ; This data section which was named as uninitialized data
 45630                                  ; (as overlayed by initialization code) but follows 
 45631                                  ; initialized data section from DOSDATA:03B6h address
 45632                                  ; (in otherwords, the method is different than MSDOS 3.3,
 45633                                  ; and there is not overlaying..)
 45634                                  ; **********************************************************
 45635                                  ; Reference: MSDOS 6.21 kernel DOSDATA section (4970 bytes)
 45636                                  ; follows DOSCODE section in the kernel file (MSDOS.SYS) 
 45637                                  ; (it is located at offset 0BF70h, file offset 0BF70h-3DE0h) 
 45638                                  ; but starts from offset 0 (ORG 0) and ends at offset 1370h.
 45639                                  ; TIMEBUF is at offset 03B6h.
 45640                                  ; **********************************************************	
 45641                                  
 45642                                  ;Break <Uninitialized data overlayed by initialization code>
 45643                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 45644                                  ;DOSDATA    SEGMENT WORD PUBLIC 'DATA'
 45645                                  ; Init code overlaps with data area below
 45646                                  
 45647                                  ; 	ORG     0
 45648                                  
 45649                                  MSDAT001S:	; label byte
 45650                                  
 45651                                  ; DOSDATA:03B6h	; MSDOS 6.21 (MSDOS.SYS, file offset 0BF70h-3DE0h+3B6h)
 45652                                  TIMEBUF: ;	times 6 db 0
 45653 000003B6 0000<rep 3h>            	times 3 dw	0		; Time read from clock device
 45654 000003BC 0000                    DEVIOBUF:	dw	0		; Buffer for I/O under file assignment
 45655                                  
 45656                                  ; The following areas are used as temp buffer in EXEC system call
 45657                                  
 45658                                  ; DOSDATA:03BEh

 45661                                  RENBUF:	
 45662 0000043E 00<rep 80h>             	times	128 db	0		; buffer for rename destination
 45663

 46098                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46099                                  ;
 46100                                  ;CASE MAPPER ROUTINE FOR 80H-FFH character range, DOS 3.3
 46101                                  ;     ENTRY: AL = Character to map
 46102                                  ;     EXIT:  AL = The converted character
 46103                                  ; Alters no registers except AL and flags.
 46104                                  ; The routine should do nothing to chars below 80H.
 46105                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46106                                  ; Example:
 46107                                  
 46108                                  MAP_CASE:
 46109                                  ;Procedure MAP_CASE,FAR
 46110                                  
 46111 00000CF5 3C80                    	CMP	AL,80h
 46112 00000CF7 7301                    	JAE	short Map1	;Map no chars below 80H ever
 46113 00000CF9 CB                      	RETF
 46114                                  Map1:
 46115 00000CFA 2C80                    	SUB	AL,80h		;Turn into index value
 46116 00000CFC 1E                      	PUSH	DS
 46117 00000CFD 53                      	PUSH	BX
 46118 00000CFE BB[AF0A]                	MOV	BX,UCASE_TAB+2
 46119                                  FINISH:
 46120 00000D01 0E                      	PUSH	CS		;Move to DS
 46121 00000D02 1F                      	POP	DS
 46122 00000D03 D7                      	XLAT			;Get upper case character
 46123 00000D04 5B                      	POP	BX
 46124 00000D05 1F                      	POP	DS
 46125                                  L_RET:
 46126 00000D06 CB                      	RETF
 46127                                  
 46128                                  ;EndProc MAP_CASE

 46706                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46707                                  ; Patch for Sidekick
 46708                                  ;
 46709                                  ; A documented method for finding the offset of the Errormode flag in the
 46710                                  ; dos swappable data area if for the app to scan in the dos segment (data)
 46711                                  ; for the following sequence of instructions.
 46712                                  ;
 46713                                  ; Ref: Part C, Article 11, pg 356 of MSDOS Encyclopedia
 46714                                  ;
 46715                                  ; The Offset of Errormode flag is 0320h
 46716                                  ;
 46717                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46718                                  
 46719 00001044 36F6062003FF            	db	036h, 0F6h, 06h, 020h, 03h, 0FFh ; test ss:[errormode], -1
 46720 0000104A 750C                    	db	075h, 0Ch			 ; jnz  NearLabel
 46721 0000104C 36FF365803              	db	036h, 0FFh, 036h, 058h, 03h	 ; push ss:[NearWord]
 46722 00001051 CD28                    	db	0CDh, 028h			 ; int  28h
 46723

 46725                                  ; Patch for PortOfEntry - M036

 46727                                  ; PortOfEntry by Sector Technology uses an un documented way of determining
 46728                                  ; the offset of Errormode flag. The following patch is to support them in 
 46729                                  ; DOS 5.0. The corresponding code is actually in msdisp.asm
 46730                                  ;
 46731                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------

 46734 00001058 7537                    	db	075h, 037h			 ; jnz	NearLabel
 46735 0000105A BCA00A                  	db 	0BCh, 0A0h, 0Ah		  	 ; mov	sp, dosdata:iostack

 46796                                  ; LOW MEM STUB:
 46797                                  ;
 46798                                  ; The low mem stub contains the entry points into DOS for all interrupts
 46799                                  ; handled by DOS. This stub is installed if the user specifies that the
 46800                                  ; DOS load in HIMEM. Each entry point does this.
 46801                                  ;
 46802                                  ; 	1. if jmp to 8 has been patched out
 46803                                  ;	   2. if A20 OFF
 46804                                  ;	      3. Enable A20
 46805                                  ;	   4. else 
 46806                                  ;	      5. just go to dos entry
 46807                                  ;	   6. endif
 46808                                  ;	7. else
 46809                                  ;	   8. just go to dos entry
 46810                                  ;	9. endif
 46811                                  ;
 46812                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46813

 46971                                  
 46972                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46973                                  ;
 46974                                  ; LowIntXX:
 46975                                  ;
 46976                                  ; Interrupts from DOS that pass control to a user program must be done from
 46977                                  ; low memory, as the user program may change the state of the A20 line or
 46978                                  ; they may require that the A20 line be OFF. The following piece of code is
 46979                                  ; far call'd from the following places in DOS:
 46980                                  ;
 46981                                  ;	1. msctrlc.asm where dos issues an int 23h (ctrlc)
 46982                                  ;	2. msctrlc.asm where dos issues an int 24h (critical error)
 46983                                  ;	3. msctrlc.asm where dos issues an int 28h (idle int)
 46984                                  ;
 46985                                  ; The int 23 and int 24 handlers may decide to do a far return instead of an
 46986                                  ; IRET ane leave the flags on the stack. Therefore we save the return address
 46987                                  ; before doing the ints and then do a far junp back into DOS.
 46988                                  ;
 46989                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46990                                  
 46991 000010DB 00000000                DosRetAddr23:	dd	0
 46992 000010DF 00000000                DosRetAddr24:	dd	0
 46993 000010E3 00000000                DosRetAddr28:	dd	0
 46994                                  
 46995                                  	; Execute int 23h from low memory
 46996                                  LowInt23:
 46997                                  					; save the return address that is on
 46998                                  					; the stack
 46999 000010E7 2E8F06[DB10]            	pop	word [cs:DosRetAddr23]
 47000 000010EC 2E8F06[DD10]            	pop	word [cs:DosRetAddr23+2]
 47001                                  
 47002 000010F1 CD23                    	int	23h			; ctrl C
 47003                                  					; turn on A20 it has been turned OFF
 47004                                  					; by int 28/23/24 handler.
 47005                                  
 47006 000010F3 E87900                  	call	EnsureA20ON		; M011: we must turn on A20 if OFF
 47007                                  
 47008 000010F6 2EFF2E[DB10]            	jmp	far [cs:DosRetAddr23]	; jump back to DOS
 47009                                  
 47010                                  
 47011                                  	; Execute int 24h from low memory
 47012                                  LowInt24:
 47013                                  					; save the return address that is on
 47014                                  					; the stack
 47015 000010FB 2E8F06[DF10]            	pop	word [cs:DosRetAddr24]
 47016 00001100 2E8F06[E110]            	pop	word [cs:DosRetAddr24+2]
 47017                                  
 47018 00001105 CD24                    	int	24h			; crit error
 47019                                  					; turn on A20 it has been turned OFF
 47020                                  					; by int 28/23/24 handler.
 47021                                  
 47022 00001107 E86500                  	call	EnsureA20ON		; M011: we must turn on A20 if OFF
 47023                                  
 47024 0000110A 2EFF2E[DF10]            	jmp	far [cs:DosRetAddr24]	; jump back to DOS
 47025                                  
 47026                                  
 47027                                  	; Execute int 28h from low memory
 47028                                  LowInt28:
 47029 0000110F CD28                    	int	28h			; idle int
 47030                                  					; turn on A20 it has been turned OFF
 47031                                  					; by int 28/23/24 handler.
 47032                                  
 47033 00001111 E85B00                  	call	EnsureA20ON		; M011: we must turn on A20 if OFF
 47034                                  
 47035 00001114 CB                      	retf
 47036                                  
 47037                                  ; DOSDATA:1115h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 47038                                  
 47039                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 47040                                  ;
 47041                                  ; int 21 ah=4b (exec) call will jump to the following label before xferring
 47042                                  ; control to the exec'd program. We turn off A20 inorder to allow programs
 47043                                  ; that have been packed by the faulty exepack utility to unpack correctly.
 47044                                  ; This is so because exepac'd programs rely on address wrap.
 47045                                  ;
 47046                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 47047                                  
 47048                                  disa20_xfer:
 47049 00001115 E83F00                  	call	XMMDisableA20		; disable A20
 47050                                  
 47051                                  	; Look at msproc.asm at label exec_go for understanding the following:
 47052                                  
 47053                                  	; DS:SI points to entry point
 47054                                  	; AX:DI points to initial stack
 47055                                  	; DX has PDB pointer
 47056                                  	; BX has initial AX value
 47057                                  
 47058 00001118 FA                      	cli
 47059 00001119 2EC606[2103]00          	mov	byte [cs:INDOS],0	; SS Override
 47060                                  
 47061 0000111F 8ED0                    	mov	SS,AX			; set up user's stack
 47062 00001121 89FC                    	mov	SP,DI			; and SP
 47063 00001123 FB                      	sti
 47064                                  
 47065 00001124 1E                      	push	DS			; fake long call to entry
 47066 00001125 56                      	push	SI
 47067 00001126 8EC2                    	mov	ES,DX			; set up proper seg registers
 47068 00001128 8EDA                    	mov	DS,DX
 47069 0000112A 89D8                    	mov	AX,BX			; set up proper AX
 47070 0000112C CB                      	retf
 47071                                  
 47072                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 47073                                  ;
 47074                                  ; M003:
 47075                                  ;
 47076                                  ; If an int 21 ah=25 call is made immediately after an exec call, DOS will
 47077                                  ; come here, turn A20 OFF restore user stack and registers before returning
 47078                                  ; to user. This is done in dos\msdisp.asm. This has been done to support
 47079                                  ; programs compiled with MS PASCAL 3.2. See under TAG M003 in DOSSYM.INC for
 47080                                  ; more info.
 47081                                  ;
 47082                                  ; Also at this point DS is DOSDATA. So we can assume DS DOSDATA. Note that
 47083                                  ; SS is also DOS stack. It is important that we do the XMS call on DOS's
 47084                                  ; stack to avoid additional stack overhead for the user.
 47085                                  ;
 47086                                  ; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 47087                                  
 47088                                  disa20_iret:
 47089 0000112D E82700                  	call	XMMDisableA20
 47090 00001130 FE0E[2103]              	dec	byte [INDOS]
 47091 00001134 8E16[8605]              	mov	SS,[USER_SS]		; restore user stack
 47092 00001138 8B26[8405]              	mov	SP,[USER_SP]
 47093 0000113C 89E5                    	mov	BP,SP
 47094                                  	;mov	[BP+user_env.user_AX],AL
 47095 0000113E 884600                  	mov	[bp],al
 47096 00001141 A1[F205]                	mov	AX,[NSP]
 47097 00001144 A3[8405]                	mov	[USER_SP],AX
 47098 00001147 A1[F005]                	mov	AX,[NSS]
 47099 0000114A A3[8605]                	mov	[USER_SS],AX
 47100                                  
 47101 0000114D 58                      	pop	AX			; restore user regs
 47102 0000114E 5B                      	pop	BX
 47103 0000114F 59                      	pop	CX
 47104 00001150 5A                      	pop	DX
 47105 00001151 5E                      	pop	SI
 47106 00001152 5F                      	pop	DI
 47107 00001153 5D                      	pop	BP
 47108 00001154 1F                      	pop	DS
 47109 00001155 07                      	pop	ES
 47110 00001156 CF                      	iret
 47111                                  
 47112                                  ;**************************************************************************
 47113                                  ;***	XMMDisableA20 - switch 20th address line
 47114                                  ;
 47115                                  ;	This routine is used to disable the 20th address line in
 47116                                  ;	the system using XMM calls.
 47117                                  ;
 47118                                  ;	ENTRY	none		;ds = _DATA
 47119                                  ;	EXIT	A20 line disabled
 47120                                  ;	USES	NOTHING
 47121                                  ;
 47122                                  ;**************************************************************************
 47123                                  
 47124                                  XMMDisableA20:
 47125 00001157 53                      	push	bx
 47126 00001158 50                      	push	ax
 47127                                  	;mov	ah,XMM_LOCAL_DISABLE_A20
 47128 00001159 B406                    	mov	ah,6
 47129 0000115B 2EFF1E[6311]            	call	far [cs:XMMcontrol]
 47130 00001160 58                      	pop	ax
 47131 00001161 5B                      	pop	bx
 47132 00001162 C3                      	retn

 47154                                  ; 25/03/2024
 47155                                  ;;19/09/2023

 47161 0000116B 9000                    	dw	00090h			; Set equal to FFFF:0090

 47165                                  	; MSDOS 5.0-6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSDATA:116Fh

 47177                                  	;;19/09/2023
 47178 00001175 2EC536[6711]            	lds	si,[cs:LowMemory]	; Compare the 4 words at 0000:0080
 47179 0000117A 2EC43E[6B11]            	les	di,[cs:HighMemory]	; with the 4 at FFFF:0090
 47180                                  
 47181                                  	; 25/03/2024
 47182                                  	;xor	di,di
 47183                                  	;mov	es,di
 47184                                  	;dec	di
