 47691                                  ;============================================================================
 47692                                  ; MPATCH.ASM (MSDOS 6.0, 1993)
 47693                                  ;============================================================================
 47694                                  ; 27/04/2019 - Retro DOS 4.0
 47695                                  
 47696                                  ;mpatch.asm -- holds data patch location for callouts 
 47697                                  ; -- allocate cluster in rom.asm
 47698                                  ;
 47699                                  ; This area is pointed to by OffsetMagicPatch[609h] in fixed DOS data.
 47700                                  ; Currently, this location is used only by magicdrv.sys's patch to
 47701                                  ; cluster allocation, however it can be expanded to be used by other
 47702                                  ; patches. This is important since we have an easy-access pointer to
 47703                                  ; this location in OffsetMagicPatch. Magicdrv.sys is guaranteed to
 47704                                  ; only patch out a far call/retf, so any space after that could be
 47705                                  ; used as a patch by using OffsetMagicPatch+6. See rom.asm on how
 47706                                  ; to call out here.
 47707                                  ;
 47708                                  ; Currently, we allocate only the minimum space required for the 6
 47709                                  ; byte magicdrv patch, so if you change the dos data, you may want
 47710                                  ; to reserve space here if your new data will be position dependent
 47711                                  ; and would prohibit growing of this table.
 47712                                  ;
 47713                                  ;history	-	created 8-7-92 by scottq
 47714                                  ;		-	added Rational386PatchPtr 2-1-93 by jimmat
 47715                                  ;
 47716                                  ;Exported Functions
 47717                                  ;==================
 47718                                  ;MagicPatch     -       callout patched by magidrv.sys for cluster allocations
 47719                                  
 47720                                  ; DosData Segment
 47721                                  
 47722                                  ; DOSDATA:1362h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 47723                                  
 47724                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 47725                                  
 47726                                  ; Rational386PatchPtr points to either a RET instruction (80286 or less) or
 47727                                  ; a routine to fix buggy versions of the Rational DOS Extender (80386 or
 47728                                  ; greater). Added to this file because it needed to be somewhere and is
 47729                                  ; 'patch' related.
 47730                                  
 47731                                  Rational386PatchPtr:
 47732                                  	dw	0	; points to patch routine or RET instr.
 47733                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 47734                                  
 47735                                  MagicPatch:
 47736                                  ;MagicPatch proc far
 47737                                          retf            ;default is to just return to allocate
 47738                                          nop             ;however, this code will be patched
 47739                                          nop             ;by magicdrv.sys to
 47740                                          nop             ; call far ?:?     
 47741                                          nop             ; retf or perhaps just jmp far
 47742                                          nop             ;retf/nop take one byte, so we need six instructions
 47743                                                          ;for 6 byte patch
 47744                                  ;MagicPatch endp
 47745                                  
 47746                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 47747                                  
 47748                                  ;DosData Ends
 47749                                  
 47750                                  ; DOSDATA:136Ah
 47751
